items.title: Closing the Gap: Automated Discovery of Secure Dockerfile Reference Standards via Semantic Clustering in Enterprise Inner Source
items.summary: Containerization dominates enterprise software delivery, yet Dockerfiles that assemble container images frequently harbor security misconfigurations and structural technical debt. This problem is poorly understood in corporate inner-source environments, where proprietary context and isolated governance prevent direct application of open-source findings. We present an automated, six-stage pipeline that: (1) crawls an enterprise GitLab instance, (2) enriches each Dockerfile with static security and quality metrics (Hadolint, ShellCheck, Trivy) and lifecycle data, (3) groups functionally identical workloads using LLM-generated semantic descriptions and HDBSCAN, and (4) quantifies the optimization gap against cluster-internal reference implementations. Applied to 11,470 Dockerfiles from over 6,200 repositories at a single large industrial company, we find a systemic deficit: 99\% of files contain at least one security misconfiguration, 80.8\% violate Dockerfile best practices, and the median artifact has not been revised for 838~days. Despite this, high-quality reference implementations already exist within 83\% of functional clusters. Adopting these internal standards would increase the average security posture score by 60.4\% without developing any new templates. These findings, grounded in one organization's inner-source ecosystem, provide a data-driven foundation for future automated, context-aware recommender systems targeting enterprise supply-chain security; whether the observed technical-debt distribution and optimization gap generalize to other enterprises remains an open question for future multi-organization study.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 本文针对企业内源（inner source）环境中 Dockerfile 安全配置缺失与技术债务普遍存在的问题展开研究。在大型企业的内部代码仓库中，由于专有上下文和隔离的治理机制，直接套用开源社区的安全发现往往不可行。作者构建了一个六阶段自动化流水线：首先爬取企业 GitLab 实例中的全部 Dockerfile；接着利用 Hadolint、ShellCheck、Trivy 等静态分析工具对每个文件进行安全与质量评分，并补充生命周期数据；然后借助大语言模型（LLM）生成语义描述，配合 HDBSCAN 聚类算法将功能相同的工作负载归组；最后量化每个集群内部实现相对最优参考实现的差距。该方法被应用于一家大型工业公司的 6,200 余个仓库中的 11,470 个 Dockerfile。结果显示，99% 的文件至少包含一种安全错误配置，80.8% 违反 Dockerfile 最佳实践，中位制品已持续 838 天未修订，暴露出系统性技术债务。然而，在 83% 的功能集群中已经存在高质量参考实现。如果采用这些内部标准，无需开发任何新模板即可将平均安全态势评分提升 60.4%。该研究为未来构建自动化、上下文感知的企业供应链安全推荐系统提供了数据驱动的基础。作者同时指出，技术债分布与优化差距是否能推广至其他企业，尚需多组织研究验证。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 该研究提供了企业内部容器安全状况的量化证据，证明通过语义聚类自动发现内部参考标准可大幅提升安全基线，为安全团队治理大规模 Dockerfile 提供了可落地的思路。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 适用于企业容器镜像构建安全评估、内源代码治理、供应链安全推荐系统等领域；可迁移到 GitHub/GitLab 等平台的大规模 Dockerfile 审计场景。
detection_signals_zh: Dockerfile 中检测到安全配置错误（如 Hadolint/Trivy 告警）
Dockerfile 违反最佳实践规则（如 ShellCheck 告警）
Dockerfile 长时间未更新（超过中位值 838 天）
defense_advice_zh: 在企业内部建立 Dockerfile 参考实现库，定期扫描并对比最佳实践
采用语义聚类自动识别功能相同的高质量实现，作为安全基线
将安全评分纳入 CI/CD 门禁，强制新镜像构建满足最低安全要求

items.title: EVOMAL: Self-Poisoning in Self-Evolving Coding Agents
items.summary: Self-evolving LLM coding agents write their own tools by imitating retrieved skills from shared skill libraries. We identify a vulnerability in this loop: during authoring, a retrieved malicious skill can become the template for a new skill that preserves the payload. We call this self-poisoning: the agent authors, stores, and runs the resulting malicious skill. We exploit it through EvoMal, an attack that amplifies self-poisoning by wrapping an interchangeable payload in a banner, a set of benign-looking structural elements that induces an imitating agent to reproduce the enclosed code. The attacker plants malicious skills in the library without invoking them. The agent then authors and executes new skills carrying the harmful code. Each authored copy can re-enter the library and be imitated again, forming a self-propagating worm that persists after the planted skills are removed. We define the agent self-poisoning rate (ASPR) as the fraction of tasks that add a newly authored malicious skill to the library. Across six models on 153 tool-relevant SWE-bench Verified tasks, ASPR ranges from 20.3% to 41.8%, and the poisoned libraries hold 4.9 to 9.0 times as many malicious skills as were planted. The vulnerability also appears without a banner: DeepSeek-V4-Pro reaches 11.1% ASPR with the payload alone. Tailoring the planted skill descriptions to one task family raises ASPR to 86.7%. After the planted skills are removed, Qwen3 retains a round-5 ASPR of 68% because agent-authored copies remain. These copies evade existing defenses, which focus on attacker-submitted names, code, and signatures. We propose counter-prompt, a defense that discourages banner-style copying and reduces EvoMal's ASPR to at most 6.7% with no significant task-completion loss.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 该论文研究自进化编码智能体（self-evolving LLM coding agents）在从共享技能库中检索技能并模仿编写自身工具时暴露出的新型安全漏洞。研究指出，在这一“编写-检索-模仿”循环中，攻击者无需直接发起调用，只需在技能库中植入名为“恶意技能”的代码样本，受害智能体在模仿学习时便可能将其中包含的恶意载荷复制到新技能中，形成“自我投毒”（self-poisoning）：智能体自己编写、存储并运行被污染的技能。作者进一步设计了EvoMal攻击，通过将可替换的载荷包裹在“横幅”（banner）中——即一组看似无害的结构化代码元素，诱导模仿中的智能体完整复现被包裹的代码。该攻击可在不调用恶意技能的情况下实现传播：智能体每编写一个恶意副本，该副本又可被其他智能体检索并模仿，形成自传播蠕虫，甚至在已植入技能被删除后仍能存活。论文定义了“智能体自我投毒率”（ASPR）作为量化指标，即新增恶意技能被写入技能库的任务比例。实验基于SWE-bench Verified中153个与工具相关的任务，覆盖六个模型，结果显示ASPR在20.3%至41.8%之间，且被污染技能库中的恶意技能数量是初始植入量的4.9至9.0倍。去掉横幅后，DeepSeek-V4-Pro在仅含裸载荷的情况下仍达到11.1%的ASPR；若将植入技能描述针对某个任务族进行定制，ASPR可升至86.7%。在清理已植入技能后，Qwen3在第五轮仍保有68%的ASPR，说明智能体自产副本具有持续性。现有防御措施主要关注攻击者提交的名称、代码和签名，无法阻止这类自复制行为。作者提出“反提示”（counter-prompt）防御机制，通过抑制横幅式复制，使EvoMal的ASPR降至至多6.7%，且任务完成度无明显下降。该研究首次系统性地揭示了自进化智能体环路中的“自我投毒”风险，为AI智能体供应链安全提供了新的研究视角。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 自进化编码智能体正在成为主流开发工具，论文揭示其核心的“自我编写”机制可被操纵形成自传播恶意软件，且现有防御手段失效。安全团队需重新审视智能体技能库的信任边界，避免仅依赖静态检查。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 影响所有采用“共享技能库+自我进化”模式的LLM编程智能体，尤其涉及工具调用、代码生成和自治代理的场景。攻击可跨模型传播、持久驻留，甚至绕过基于签名和代码扫描的传统防护。

items.why_it_matters: 自进化编码智能体正在成为主流开发工具，论文揭示其核心的“自我编写”机制可被操纵形成自传播恶意软件，且现有防御手段失效。安全团队需重新审视智能体技能库的信任边界，避免仅依赖静态检查。

items.title: Toward Interpretable Privacy Guarantees in Face-Swapping Anonymization
items.summary: Face-swapping has emerged as a promising approach to facial privacy protection, replacing a target individual's appearance with that of a donor while preserving non-facial context. The resulting images visually resemble the donor, and face recognition systems tend to suppress the target's match scores -- ostensibly satisfying privacy requirements. Empirical evaluation across a range of face-swapping models, however, reveals that significant target identity leakage still occurs. This raises a deeper question: why does leakage occur, and can it be predicted? We propose a linear stochastic model that treats face-swappers as transformations on the space of identity embeddings, providing an interpretable account of the leakage mechanism. The model is fit to empirical observations and used to derive testable predictions. The aim is to ground privacy assessments in principled, interpretable analysis, thus making formal privacy guarantees explainable -- and perfectible -- rather than purely observational.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 该论文研究面部替换（face-swapping）匿名化技术中的隐私泄露问题。面部替换通过将目标人物的外观替换为捐赠者的外观，同时保留非面部上下文，生成视觉上接近捐赠者的图像，并通常导致人脸识别系统对目标人物的匹配分数降低，表面上满足隐私保护需求。然而，作者对多种面部替换模型的实证评估发现，目标身份信息仍存在显著泄露。针对这一现象，论文提出一个线性随机模型，将面部替换器视为身份嵌入空间上的变换，从而为泄露机制提供可解释的刻画。该模型基于实测数据进行拟合，并用于推导可检验的预测。研究目标是将隐私评估建立在有原则、可解释的分析基础上，使正式隐私保证变得可解释且可改进，而非仅停留在观测层面。论文的核心贡献包括：揭示现有面部替换匿名化中的身份泄露问题、提出一种可解释的线性随机模型以解释泄露成因、以及通过实证数据验证模型预测。适合对人脸隐私保护、匿名化技术评估及可解释AI安全感兴趣的研究人员阅读。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 面部替换被广泛用于隐私保护，但实际身份泄露风险可能被低估。该研究提供可解释的模型来预测和量化泄露，有助于构建更可靠的隐私评估标准，对依赖人脸匿名化的合规场景有参考价值。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 影响人脸匿名化产品的隐私效果评估，可迁移至其他图像生成模型的隐私泄露分析场景。

items.title: MeMark: Membrane-Space Watermarking for Spiking Neural Networks
items.summary: Spiking Neural Networks (SNNs) are increasingly distributed as pretrained checkpoints and reused as backbones for new tasks. However, current SNN watermarks are mainly verified against the model output. Thus, a user who replaces the output head can keep most of the original network while removing the evidence used for verification. We present MeMark, a watermark designed for the checkpoint-reuse setting. Instead of storing the watermark in the output head, MeMark embeds a multi-bit identifier in the internal membrane state of selected Leaky Integrate-and-Fire (LIF) neurons. A secret input drives each selected neuron to the chosen side of its own firing threshold, and the same threshold is later used to recover the secret bit, so the verifier does not need a learned decoder. We evaluate MeMark across recurrent, convolutional, residual, and transformer SNNs. On a 215.4M-parameter SpikeGPT checkpoint, all 20 independent 64-bit keys pass the fixed 51/64 verification rule, while none of the $30\,000$ fresh random keys pass when tested against all 20 protected checkpoints and the clean model. All 20 genuine keys also remain above the threshold after fine-tuning, 90\% pruning, int8 quantization, and output-head replacement. Under our stated threat model, adaptive attacks can weaken the watermark but do not remove the ownership evidence in the settings we test. Additionally, we study false ownership claims, key-aware and key-agnostic removal, partial key disclosure, rollback, and extraction into a student. The results show that MeMark can provide evidence of checkpoint derivatives, while being resistant to the adversary's attacks and complete head replacement.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 该论文提出了一种针对脉冲神经网络（SNN）的模型水印方法 MeMark，用于解决预训练 checkpoint 被复用时的版权归属问题。现有的 SNN 水印通常把验证信号放在模型输出层，攻击者只要替换输出头（output head）就能在保留大部分网络参数的同时清除验证证据。MeMark 则将多比特水印嵌入到选定的 Leaky Integrate-and-Fire（LIF）神经元的内部膜电位状态中。具体来说，使用一个秘密输入驱动每个被选中的神经元，使其膜电位朝向自身放电阈值的特定一侧，之后再用同一阈值恢复对应的水印比特，因此验证过程不需要额外的学习解码器。论文在循环、卷积、残差和 Transformer 等多种 SNN 架构上进行了评估。在 215.4M 参数的 SpikeGPT checkpoint 上，20 个独立的 64 位密钥全部通过固定的 51/64 验证规则；同时，在针对 20 个受保护 checkpoint 和干净模型的测试中，30000 个随机密钥无一通过。此外，所有 20 个正版密钥在微调、90% 剪枝、int8 量化和输出头替换后仍保持在阈值之上。在所声明的威胁模型下，自适应攻击可以削弱水印，但在测试环境中无法完全移除所有权证据。论文还研究了误判所有权声明、密钥感知/密钥无关的移除、部分密钥泄露、回滚攻击以及提取到学生模型等场景。结果表明，MeMark 能够为 checkpoint 派生模型提供所有权证据，并对抗攻击者替换输出头的操作。该工作适合关注 SNN 模型知识产权保护、模型水印鲁棒性以及 AI 资产安全的研究人员和蓝队工程师阅读。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: SNN 模型作为预训练主干被复用时，传统输出层水印易被简单移除。MeMark 首次在膜电位空间嵌入水印，不影响输出头更换，为 AI 模型版权溯源提供了新的思路，对防御方监控模型窃取和未授权复用有参考价值。

items.title: Pointing the Way, Hiding the Destination: Practical Private Dense Retrieval at Scale
items.summary: Hosted retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) and semantic search allow users to query valuable provider-held corpora, raising two competing demands: to hide each query and chosen result, yet reveal only the documents that the user is authorized to receive. Existing cryptographic approaches either make this costly by processing the entire corpus for every query, or sacrifice quality for efficiency by scanning a few clusters. We repurpose learned deep hashing as a private filter: a randomized binary code points the provider to a short candidate list, while encrypted reranking and oblivious key transfer protect the precise query and final selection. This shortlist short-circuits full-corpus cryptographic search without sacrificing retrieval quality: with 200-500 candidates, it closely matches full-corpus retrieval across five zero-shot corpora spanning 25K to 5.4M documents. On the full 2.68M-passage NQ corpus over a 10-Gbps link, our protocol only adds 0.73 seconds, or 10 percent, to a 128-token Qwen3-32B RAG pipeline. The released code satisfies directional metric differential privacy (DP) and substantially reduces embedding-inversion and property-inference leakage, demonstrating that a carefully learned shortlist can make private dense retrieval both accurate and practical.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 本文提出了一种实用的私有稠密检索方案，用于托管式检索增强生成（RAG）和语义搜索场景。核心矛盾在于：用户希望隐藏自己的查询和最终选中的文档，而服务提供商希望只向授权用户暴露其有权访问的文档，同时保护语料库的机密性。现有密码学方法要么对每个查询都要处理整个语料库，成本高昂；要么通过扫描少量聚类来牺牲检索质量以换取效率。作者将学习型深度哈希重新设计为一种“私有过滤器”：通过随机化的二进制编码，服务提供商只需根据该编码返回一个较短的候选列表，随后通过加密的重排序和 oblivious key transfer 来保护精确查询和最终选择，避免了对全语料库进行密码学计算。实验表明，在包含 2.5 万到 540 万文档的五个零样本语料库上，仅需 200-500 个候选文档即可逼近全语料库检索的质量。在完整的 268 万段落 NQ 语料库上，基于 10 Gbps 链路，该协议仅为使用 128 token 的 Qwen3-32B RAG 流水线增加了 0.73 秒（约 10%）的延迟。发布的代码满足定向度量差分隐私（DP），并大幅减少了嵌入反演和属性推断泄漏。这项工作证明，精心学习的短列表可以同时实现私有稠密检索的准确性和实用性。适合对隐私保护检索、RAG 安全、密码学与机器学习交叉领域感兴趣的研究人员和工程师阅读。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 该研究为托管 RAG 和语义搜索提供了实用的隐私保护方案，能在不显著牺牲性能的情况下隐藏用户查询和结果，对依赖第三方知识库的 AI 应用具有直接参考价值。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 可应用于需要隐私保护的企业级知识库问答、合规要求的语义搜索、多方数据共享场景中，也可为 LLM 代理提供私有化的上下文集获取。

items.why_it_matters: 该研究为托管 RAG 和语义搜索提供了实用的隐私保护方案，能在不显著牺牲性能的情况下隐藏用户查询和结果，对依赖第三方知识库的 AI 应用具有直接参考价值。

items.title: From Verdict to Diagnosis: Attributable Security Review of Pull Requests
items.summary: Automated code reviewers are increasingly used as gates on pull requests (PRs), yet evaluations measure whether they block a malicious change. A block may be triggered by an unrelated issue rather than the vulnerability that makes the PR unsafe; fixing the reported issue can leave the target defect exploitable. We call this discrepancy the Verdict-Diagnosis (VD) gap. We present MalPR-Bench, a mechanism-grounded benchmark of 89 malicious PRs and 50 paired benign controls across 44 repositories and eight language families. Each malicious case has a pre-committed rubric specifying the target vulnerability, accepted mechanism descriptions, required repository evidence, and off-target findings receiving no credit. Reviews are scored separately for verdict correctness, target-vulnerability identification, and evidence validation; an attributable block requires all three. We introduce PRGuard, an attributable PR security reviewer that constructs candidate vulnerabilities and validates their premises against repository evidence using deterministic, non-executing tools and bounded retrieval. Across 31 common-coverage held-out malicious PRs, PRGuard and CodeRabbit produce similar blocking totals (22/31 vs. 24/31), but PRGuard identifies 22 target vulnerabilities versus 16 for CodeRabbit, a 1.38x difference. On 14 absence-type cases, both block 9, while PRGuard identifies 9 targets versus 3. CodeRabbit identifies 16/24 targets when required evidence lies within touched files and 0/7 when validation requires evidence outside them. Finally, PRGuard uncovers twelve previously undisclosed, proof-of-concept-backed vulnerabilities across five projects. PRGuard/DeepSeek and CodeRabbit both block 10/12 discovery PRs, but produce 10/12 and 4/12 attributable blocks, respectively. Thus, verdict-only evaluation can substantially overstate the security value of automated review.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 本文聚焦自动化代码审查在拉取请求（PR）安全门禁中的评估缺陷。现有评估指标通常只关注是否阻止了恶意变更，但阻止可能由无关问题触发，而非真正导致PR不安全的漏洞；修复所报告的问题后，目标漏洞仍可能被利用。作者将此称为“裁决-诊断差距”（Verdict-Diagnosis Gap）。为解决此问题，他们提出了MalPR-Bench，一个基于机制标注的基准，包含44个仓库、8种语言家族中的89个恶意PR和50个配对良性对照。每个恶意案例都预先提交了评估标准，明确目标漏洞、接受的机制描述、所需仓库证据以及不计分的非目标发现。评分分别针对裁决正确性、目标漏洞识别和证据验证进行；只有三者同时满足才算“可归因阻止”。他们进一步提出PRGuard，一个可归因的PR安全审查器，它利用确定性、非执行的工具和有界检索，构造候选漏洞并验证其前提与仓库证据的一致性。在31个常见覆盖的保留恶意PR上，PRGuard与CodeRabbit的阻止总数相近（22/31 vs 24/31），但PRGuard识别出22个目标漏洞，而CodeRabbit仅识别出16个，差距为1.38倍。在14个缺失类型案例中，两者都阻止了9个，但PRGuard识别出9个目标，而CodeRabbit仅识别出3个。当所需证据位于接触文件中时，CodeRabbit能识别16/24个目标；当验证需要外部证据时，只能识别0/7个。最后，PRGuard在五个项目中发现了十二个此前未公开、基于概念验证支持的漏洞。在发现PR上，PRGuard/DeepSeek和CodeRabbit都阻止了10/12个，但可归因阻止分别是10/12和4/12。研究结论是：仅依赖裁决结果的评估可能显著高估自动化审查的安全价值。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 该研究揭示了当前AI代码审查评估方式的根本缺陷，为蓝队选择和使用自动化PR审查工具提供了量化依据，帮助避免被“阻止率”误导，从而更准确地评估漏洞发现能力。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 影响所有依赖自动化代码审查作为安全门禁的DevSecOps流程；方法论可迁移至其他安全任务评估（如漏洞扫描、恶意代码检测）。

items.why_it_matters: 该研究揭示了当前AI代码审查评估方式的根本缺陷，为蓝队选择和使用自动化PR审查工具提供了量化依据，帮助避免被“阻止率”误导，从而更准确地评估漏洞发现能力。

items.title: NeuronFuzz: Safety Neuron Guided Fuzzing for LLM Safety Evaluation
items.summary: Safety evaluation is critical for assessing whether aligned Large Language Models (LLMs) remain robust against jailbreak attacks. Existing automated testing methods, however, largely rely on response-level feedback: each candidate prompt typically requires generating a target-model response to evaluate its attack effectiveness. This process is expensive and, more importantly, provides only sparse guidance on strongly aligned models, where most candidates are rejected with the same failure outcome. This paper presents NeuronFuzz, a white-box fuzzing framework that exploits internal safety neurons as continuous execution feedback for LLM safety evaluation. A SafetyOracle converts safety-neuron activations into a continuous safety alarm score that serves as feedback for fuzzing and can be obtained during prefill, eliminating response generation from the fuzzing loop. To construct the SafetyOracle, NeuronFuzz uses template-invariant harmful and benign inputs and stability-aware selection to identify a compact set of safety neurons whose activations capture harmful-intent recognition. Moreover, since the safety alarm score is differentiable, NeuronFuzz uses its gradients to identify safety-sensitive template positions and a masked language model to generate fluent, context-compatible mutations while preserving original harmful payload and avoiding additional optimization variables. We evaluate NeuronFuzz across 21 text and multimodal models. Across five white-box source models, it achieves a 76-100% jailbreak discovery rate, outperforming baselines by up to 48 percentage points. Its optimized templates further transfer zero-shot to open-weight and six proprietary target models, achieving average ASR and top-5 ensemble ASR (EASR) of 69.6%/92.6% and 44.1%/60.0%, respectively.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 本文提出 NeuronFuzz，一个面向大语言模型（LLM）安全评估的白盒模糊测试框架。研究背景在于：现有针对越狱攻击的自动化测试方法大多依赖响应级反馈，即每个候选提示词都需要让目标模型生成完整回复来评估攻击是否成功。这一过程计算开销大，且在强对齐模型上反馈信号稀疏——大量候选都被同样拒绝，难以提供有效的指导信号。NeuronFuzz 的核心思想是利用模型内部的安全神经元激活值作为连续的执行反馈，替代昂贵的响应生成。作者设计了一个 SafetyOracle 模块，通过模板不变的恶意/良性输入和稳定性感知选择，识别出一组紧凑的安全神经元，并将其激活值转换为连续的安全警报分数。该分数可在预填充阶段获取，从而将响应生成从模糊测试循环中移除。由于该分数可微，NeuronFuzz 利用梯度定位对安全敏感的模板位置，并通过掩码语言模型生成流畅且上下文兼容的变异，同时保留原有恶意载荷，避免引入额外优化变量。实验覆盖 21 个文本和多模态模型：在 5 个白盒源模型上实现了 76%–100% 的越狱发现率，比基线高出最多 48 个百分点；优化后的模板能够零样本迁移到开放权重模型和 6 个专有目标模型，平均攻击成功率（ASR）与 top-5 集成 ASR 分别达到 69.6%/92.6% 和 44.1%/60.0%。该工作为 LLM 安全评估提供了一种高效的白盒方法，特别适合需要大规模、低成本评估模型鲁棒性的场景。适合安全研究人员、模型评测团队和 LLM 安全工程师阅读。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 传统越狱测试依赖完整响应生成，成本高且反馈稀疏。NeuronFuzz 首次利用安全神经元激活作为连续反馈，大幅提升白盒越狱发现的效率和迁移性，为 LLM 安全评估提供了新范式。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 可能影响 LLM 安全评估工具链的设计，尤其是对安全对齐模型的鲁棒性测试。其白盒方法可迁移到开源模型评估，但专有模型需通过黑盒迁移，具体防御价值需进一步验证。

items.why_it_matters: 传统越狱测试依赖完整响应生成，成本高且反馈稀疏。NeuronFuzz 首次利用安全神经元激活作为连续反馈，大幅提升白盒越狱发现的效率和迁移性，为 LLM 安全评估提供了新范式。

items.title: Are LLM-Enhanced GNNs Privacy-Safe?
items.summary: Large language models (LLMs) have recently advanced graph neural networks (GNNs) by enriching node representations with semantic information, giving rise to LLM-enhanced GNNs that achieve substantial performance gains. However, their vulnerability to privacy attacks, in which adversaries infer sensitive information from model outputs, remains largely underexplored. To bridge this gap, we present a systematic evaluation of privacy risks in LLM-enhanced GNNs through a unified framework consisting of five stages: (1) dataset preparation, (2) victim model training, (3) privacy attack, (4) risk assessment, and (5) defense analysis. Specifically, we conduct experiments on six real-world text-attributed graph datasets covering diverse domains. We consider six representative privacy attack methods targeting three fundamental threats, namely link, label, and membership inference, and construct 42 victim model configurations by combining multiple LLM-based feature enhancers with representative GNN backbones. Extensive experiments show that, despite their utility improvements, LLM-enhanced GNNs consistently exhibit increased vulnerability to privacy attacks compared to shallow text representation baselines. Further analysis reveals that semantic enrichment amplifies link-, label-, and membership-related signals in the embedding space, making them more exploitable by inference attacks. Finally, we evaluate differential privacy as a defense strategy and show that, while it can partially mitigate privacy risks, it introduces significant utility degradation, highlighting a fundamental privacy-utility trade-off in LLM-enhanced graph learning. Overall, this work provides a comprehensive understanding of privacy risks in LLM-enhanced GNNs and offers practical insights for developing more secure and trustworthy graph learning systems.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 本研究（arXiv论文“Are LLM-Enhanced GNNs Privacy-Safe?”）系统性地评估了LLM增强图神经网络（GNN）在隐私攻击面前的脆弱性。近年来，大型语言模型（LLM）通过向图节点表示中注入语义信息，显著提升了GNN的性能，催生了LLM-enhanced GNN这一新兴范式。然而，此类模型在下游任务中可能遭受隐私攻击——攻击者可从模型输出中推断敏感信息，这一问题此前缺乏系统研究。为填补空白，作者提出了一个包含五个阶段的统一评估框架：数据集准备、受害者模型训练、隐私攻击、风险评估与防御分析。他们在六个真实世界文本属性图数据集上展开实验，覆盖不同领域；并选择了六种代表性隐私攻击方法，针对三类基本威胁：链接推理、属性/标签推理和成员推理。通过将多种基于LLM的特征增强器与典型GNN骨干组合，构造了42种受害者模型配置。大量实验表明：尽管LLM增强提升了模型效用，但这些模型相比于浅层文本表示基线，持续地表现出更高的隐私攻击脆弱性。进一步分析揭示，语义增强在嵌入空间中放大了与链接、标签和成员相关的信号，使得推理攻击更易提取敏感信息。最后，作者评估了差分隐私作为防御手段的效果，发现它只能部分缓解隐私风险，却会带来显著的效用损失，突显了LLM增强图学习中的根本性隐私-效用权衡。该工作为理解LLM-enhanced GNN的隐私风险提供了全面认识，并为构建更安全可信的图学习系统提供了实践见解。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: LLM增强GNN在社交网络、推荐系统等领域应用广泛，但隐私风险尚未被充分认知。本研究表明这类模型比传统方法更容易遭受链接、标签和成员隐私推理攻击，安全团队需评估自身图学习系统的隐私暴露面。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 影响使用文本属性图进行节点分类等任务的LLM-GNN系统，尤其涉及用户敏感关系的社交网络、知识图谱场景。
defense_advice_zh: 考虑差分隐私训练，但需权衡效用损失
限制模型输出中嵌入向量的精细度
在部署前进行隐私风险评估

items.why_it_matters: LLM增强GNN在社交网络、推荐系统等领域应用广泛，但隐私风险尚未被充分认知。本研究表明这类模型比传统方法更容易遭受链接、标签和成员隐私推理攻击，安全团队需评估自身图学习系统的隐私暴露面。

items.title: Reassembling Distributed Risk: Trajectory-Conditioned Action Generation for Multi-Turn Agent Safety
items.summary: Tool-using LLM agents extend security risks beyond generated text to actions that affect external systems. Under multi-turn decomposition attacks, a harmful objective can be distributed across individually plausible requests and tool calls, becoming apparent only from the accumulated trajectory. Existing defenses either rely on auxiliary online reasoning to recover long-horizon security evidence or assess actions after generation, often incurring additional inference cost or depending on runtime-specific action representations. We propose \emph{Reassembling Distributed Risk} (ReDiR), a generation-time defense that conditions action generation on trajectory-level security evidence. Before each action, ReDiR compresses the current trajectory into a compact latent safety representation and injects it into the frozen base model. The representation is learned through same-model, cross-view supervision, where safe behavior from an explicit task view provides supervision for recovering distributed safety evidence from the original multi-turn trajectory. This design enables ReDiR to integrate cross-turn security information directly within the generation process without relying on a separate action-level safety module. We evaluate ReDiR on two agent-safety benchmarks across three model families and eight held-out tool domains. ReDiR reduces attack success rates to below 8\%, transfers to unseen tool domains, and preserves benign fidelity with low computational overhead.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 本文提出名为 ReDiR (Reassembling Distributed Risk) 的生成时防御方法，针对工具型 LLM 智能体在多轮对话分解攻击下面临的安全风险。这类攻击将有害目标拆解为多个看似合理的请求和工具调用，只有在完整轨迹中累积显现。现有防御要么依赖附加在线推理恢复长程安全证据，要么在生成后评估动作，带来额外推理成本或依赖运行时特定的动作表示。ReDiR 在生成每个动作前，将当前轨迹压缩为紧凑的潜在安全表示并注入冻结的基础模型，通过同模型跨视图监督学习该表示，使得生成过程本身即整合跨轮安全信息，无需独立动作级安全模块。论文在两个智能体安全基准、三个模型族、八个保留工具域上评估，将攻击成功率降至 8% 以下，且能迁移到未见工具域，对良性任务保真度影响小、计算开销低。主要贡献：方法创新（基于轨迹级安全证据的条件动作生成）、消除额外推理成本、跨域迁移能力。适合 LLM 安全、AI agent 防护、红蓝队研究人员阅读。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 该研究为多轮交互型 LLM 智能体提供了一种不依赖外部安全模块、在生成时内化轨迹风险的自防御范式，对 SOC/蓝队评估 agent 类应用供应链风险和设计运行时缓解措施具有直接参考价值。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 适用于多轮工具调用型 LLM agent 场景（如自动化运维、客服机器人、代码生成代理）的安全防护，可迁移到未知工具域。

items.why_it_matters: 该研究为多轮交互型 LLM 智能体提供了一种不依赖外部安全模块、在生成时内化轨迹风险的自防御范式，对 SOC/蓝队评估 agent 类应用供应链风险和设计运行时缓解措施具有直接参考价值。

items.title: LMSM: LLM Security Framework Inspired by Linux Security Modules
items.summary: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly deployed with layered defenses, yet malicious prompts can still bypass them. Interpretability methods can expose model-internal signals along the generation path that could inform enforcement, but these signals are not security controls by themselves. Deployments that adapt them for safety typically couple each signal to its own calibration, policy logic, and intervention code, so each new artifact creates integration work instead of strengthening a shared defense. We present Language Model Security Modules (LMSM), a security framework that adapts the separation behind Linux Security Modules (LSM) to LLM serving. In LMSM, a selected security backend exposes calibrated evidence, a versioned policy evaluates active rules over trusted per-request context, and a separate gate authorizes buffered output release. This design separates mediation correctness from policy effectiveness, and it allows backend, rule, or schedule changes without rebuilding request handling or enforcement. Our prototype shows the separation working in practice: with Hugging Face Transformers and continuously batched vLLM, the same substrate hosts artifact-backed sparse autoencoder (SAE) and transcoder deployments and task-fitted dense probes, preserves request-specific decisions under scheduler churn, and selectively enforces and composes multiple rules per request. On Qwen3-4B, LMSM-Checkpoint reduces HarmBench attack success rate from 39.20% to 3.32%, with XSTest false refusals rising from 2.40% to 4.40%, while retaining 98.14% of the throughput of a matched serving path that performs no monitoring work at 32 active sequences. LMSM gives advances in interpretability and model-internal analysis a common path to runtime enforcement.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 该论文提出了一种面向大语言模型（LLM）的安全框架 LMSM（Language Model Security Modules），其设计灵感来自 Linux 安全模块（LSM）的架构分离思想。当前 LLM 服务通常叠加多层防御，但恶意提示仍可绕过；可解释性方法能够沿生成路径暴露模型内部信号，但这些信号本身并非安全控制，实际部署中若将其用于安全，往往需要为每个信号单独定制校准、策略逻辑和干预代码，导致重复集成工作且难以形成统一防线。LMSM 将安全功能解耦为三个独立组件：安全后端（backend）负责提供经过校准的证据（如稀疏自编码器 SAE、transcoder、密集探针等可解释性产物）、版本化策略模块（policy）根据可信的每请求上下文评估活动规则、以及独立的门控模块（gate）授权缓冲输出的释放。这种设计将中介正确性与策略有效性分离，允许后端、规则或调度策略独立更新，而无需重建请求处理或执行逻辑。原型系统基于 Hugging Face Transformers 和连续批处理推理引擎 vLLM 构建，在 Qwen3-4B 模型上验证了有效性：LMSM-Checkpoint 将 HarmBench 攻击成功率从 39.20% 降至 3.32%，而 XSTest 误拒绝率仅从 2.40% 升至 4.40%，同时在 32 个并发序列下保留了匹配基准路径 98.14% 的吞吐量（该基准不执行监控）。此外，原型展示了在调度器波动下仍能保持请求级决策的一致性，并支持对单个请求选择性执行和组合多条规则。该框架为可解释性和模型内部分析方法提供了通向运行时强制执行的通用途径，是 LLM 安全架构研究的重要进展。适合 LLM 安全研究人员、AI 红蓝队成员以及负责大模型服务加固的工程师阅读。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 该框架将 Linux 安全模块的成熟设计移植到 LLM 服务，有望统一分散的可解释性防御，降低安全策略集成成本，并为模型内部信号提供标准化的强制路径。

items.why_it_matters: 该框架将 Linux 安全模块的成熟设计移植到 LLM 服务，有望统一分散的可解释性防御，降低安全策略集成成本，并为模型内部信号提供标准化的强制路径。

items.title: Adversarial Training of Linear Models under Stealthy Attacks
items.summary: Predictive models are widely used in many fields, but are vulnerable to false data injection attacks. To address this, detection schemes and adversarial training have been proposed, but such approaches lack guarantees against stealthy attacks. We therefore propose a detector-based switched model, in which optimal attack strategies are stealthy. For linear prediction models, we derive a convex formulation of the resulting adversarial risk. The model incorporates protected features and introduces a hyperparameter modelling attack probability, enabling an explicit performance trade-off between clean and attacked data regimes. Numerical simulations on real and synthetic data show improved performance on partially attacked data, even for misspecified attack probabilities.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 本文研究线性预测模型在隐蔽虚假数据注入攻击下的对抗训练问题。预测模型在诸多领域广泛部署，但对数据完整性攻击较为敏感，攻击者可通过注入精心设计的虚假数据使模型输出产生偏差。现有检测方案和对抗训练方法虽能提升鲁棒性，却缺乏对隐蔽攻击（即能绕过检测器的最优攻击）的严格保证。为此，作者提出一种基于检测器的切换模型：系统根据检测器输出在“正常模式”与“受保护模式”之间切换，并证明在该模型下，攻击者的最优攻击策略天然具备隐蔽性，且此时对抗风险可被表示为凸函数。该模型进一步引入受保护特征（protected features）以及一个刻画攻击发生概率的超参数，从而在干净数据与受攻击数据之间提供显式的性能权衡。作者对线性预测模型推导了凸的对抗风险公式，并在真实与合成数据集上进行数值模拟，验证了所提方法在部分受攻击数据上的性能优于基线，即使攻击概率被错误指定（即先验不准确）时依然有效。核心贡献包括：首次为隐蔽攻击下的线性模型给出可处理的凸对抗训练框架；通过切换机制将检测器集成进训练目标；提供超参数化权衡界面，便于实际应用按需调节鲁棒性与正常性能。适合机器学习安全、控制理论与对抗样本研究方向的研究者阅读。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 该研究为线性模型在隐蔽攻击下的鲁棒性提供了理论保证与可计算框架，帮助安全工程理解“可绕过检测器”的攻击场景，并为设计更可靠的预测系统提供基础。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 适用于基于线性回归或线性分类器的工业控制、电力系统状态估计、金融预测等场景，可迁移至其他凸模型。

items.why_it_matters: 该研究为线性模型在隐蔽攻击下的鲁棒性提供了理论保证与可计算框架，帮助安全工程理解“可绕过检测器”的攻击场景，并为设计更可靠的预测系统提供基础。

items.title: An Analysis of the Impact of Psychological Factors and Techniques Across Different Types of Social Engineering
items.summary: Phishing is a well-known social engineering (SE) type used to trick individuals into revealing personal information or performing desired actions, like downloading and installing malware. Other SE types, like vishing and smishing, have emerged and are increasingly being used. As SE continues to successfully persuade victims into actions, the questions arise of which SE attack types are most effective for specific psychological factors (PFs) and, conversely, which PFs are most effective for particular attack types. To answer these questions, we conducted a laboratory study with n=12 participants, in which each participant was shown all 25 stimuli (five PFs and five SE types). The results of this exploratory study show that the most effective SE attack type for authority, trust, and greed was spear-phishing. The most successful combination of PF and attack type was spear-phishing using greed. The least successful combinations were pop-ups using authority, smishing using authority, and vishing using curiosity, each having had no success at all.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 本文是一篇关于社会工程学攻击中心理因素与攻击类型相互作用的研究论文。研究背景在于，网络钓鱼（phishing）是最广为人知的社会工程学攻击类型，通过欺骗受害者泄露个人信息或执行恶意操作（如下载安装恶意软件）。随着攻击手段演化，语音钓鱼（vishing）和短信钓鱼（smishing）等新型攻击方式逐渐兴起。尽管社会工程学攻击持续取得成功，但学术界对'哪些攻击类型针对特定心理因素最有效'以及'哪些心理因素在特定攻击类型中发挥最大作用'仍缺乏系统性认知。为回答上述问题，作者设计了一项实验室研究，招募了12名参与者，向每位参与者展示了全部25种刺激组合（5种心理因素 × 5种攻击类型）。心理因素包括权威（authority）、信任（trust）、贪婪（greed）、好奇心（curiosity）等（具体五类在abstract中未完整列出），攻击类型包括鱼叉式网络钓鱼（spear-phishing）、弹出窗口（pop-ups）、语音钓鱼（vishing）、短信钓鱼（smishing）等。实验结果表明：（1）针对权威、信任和贪婪这三种心理因素，最有效的攻击类型是鱼叉式网络钓鱼；（2）在所有心理因素与攻击类型的组合中，利用贪婪的鱼叉式网络钓鱼成功率最高；（3）失败率最高的组合包括：利用权威的弹出窗口、利用权威的短信钓鱼、以及利用好奇心的语音钓鱼，这三组组合完全未获得成功。作为一项探索性研究，该实验样本量较小（n=12），结果虽不足以做大规模统计推断，但为后续研究提供了初步方向。论文的核心贡献在于建立了社会工程学攻击类型与心理因素之间匹配关系的实证基础，帮助防御方理解攻击者如何选择攻击向量，从而设计更具针对性的安全意识培训与防护策略。适合关注人因安全、安全意识教育及社会工程学防御机制的研究人员和安全从业者阅读。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 该研究揭示了不同社会工程学攻击与心理因素的匹配有效性，帮助蓝队理解攻击者最可能利用的心理弱点，并能据此优化安全意识培训与模拟钓鱼演练的优先级。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 可作为社会工程学防御策略的参考依据，但限于探索性样本，具体结论需谨慎推广；对安全意识培训内容设计有直接参考价值。

items.why_it_matters: 该研究揭示了不同社会工程学攻击与心理因素的匹配有效性，帮助蓝队理解攻击者最可能利用的心理弱点，并能据此优化安全意识培训与模拟钓鱼演练的优先级。

items.title: AI Slop and Hallucinations in Vulnerability Assessment: A Survey on Reasoning Failures and Trustworthy Mitigation
items.summary: The integration of Large Language Models (LLMs) into cybersecurity has transformed vulnerability assessment, but it has also produced a trustworthiness crisis driven by the unchecked proliferation of "AI slop." These artifacts, hallucinated vulnerabilities, plausible but incorrect patches, and semantically repackaged bug reports, impose a cognitive burden on human triage pipelines that mirrors a denial-of-service attack. This paper surveys the empirical evidence, identifies a unifying mechanism, and traces a path toward trustworthy triage. We formalize a taxonomy of AI slop grounded in a structured literature review and dissect its root cause: the gap between the causal deductive reasoning of security experts and the autoregressive probabilistic generation of current LLMs. We operationalize this gap through a measurable proxy, the Deductive Coverage Score, and show that chain-of-thought prompting and tool-using agents narrow but do not close it. We review mitigation strategies and argue that passive detection and watermarking target provenance rather than correctness, facing fundamental entropy constraints. We instead advocate for active neuro-symbolic verification, mapping each pipeline component to prior systems with documented limits on security inputs. Finally, we specify two evaluation instruments, CVE-Bench and Slop-Score, including dataset construction, metric formulas, and anti-gaming provisions. By shifting evaluation from linguistic fluency to mathematical verifiability, this survey provides a roadmap for securing emerging AI-driven triage systems.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 本论文是一篇关于大型语言模型（LLM）在漏洞评估中产生“AI 垃圾”（AI slop）现象的系统性综述。研究背景是，LLM 的引入虽极大提升了漏洞评估的自动化水平，但也引发信任危机：模型可能生成幻觉漏洞、看似合理但错误的补丁，以及语义重复或改写的漏洞报告，这些低质量产物统称为“AI slop”。这类输出会在人工分诊流程中造成巨大的认知负担，甚至形成类似拒绝服务攻击的效果，淹没真正的安全告警。作者通过结构化文献综述，正式提出了 AI slop 的分类法，并剖析其统一根因：安全专家依赖因果演绎推理，而当前 LLM 基于自回归式概率生成，二者存在根本性“推理差距”。为量化该差距，论文提出可测代理指标“演绎覆盖率分数”（Deductive Coverage Score）。实验梳理表明，思维链提示（CoT）和工具调用型智能体虽能缩小这一差距，但无法完全消除。作者进一步论证，被动式检测方法（如水印）只能追踪输出来源，不能验证输出正确性，且面临熵约束的严重局限；因此，更可靠的路是主动式神经符号验证，即将神经网络的语义理解与符号推理的形式保证相结合，并为流水线各组件匹配已有安全输入限制系统。论文最后设计了两个评估工具：CVE-Bench 和 Slop-Score，详细说明数据集构建、评估指标公式及防作弊机制。核心贡献在于将漏洞评估的验证标准从“语言流畅度”转向“数学可验证性”，为构建可信赖的 AI 驱动漏洞分诊系统提供了路线图。适合安全研究人员、LLM 应用开发者和漏洞管理平台设计者阅读。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 随着 LLM 越来越多地融入漏洞评估与安全运营，AI 生成的低质或幻觉内容可能误导排查、浪费人力甚至引入新风险。该综述首次系统定义并量化这种“AI slop”现象，为防御者识别和缓解此类风险提供了理论依据和评估工具。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 影响所有使用 LLM 进行漏洞分析、自动补丁生成和安全情报整理的系统；安全运营中心（SOC）的告警分诊流程极易被 AI 生成的虚假信息干扰。提出的评估方法可迁移到其他依赖 LLM 输出正确性的安全场景。
detection_signals_zh: 漏洞描述与补丁代码行为不一致
补丁未实际修复对应 CVE 或引入新问题
多个报告内容高度相似但语义被改写
LLM 输出置信度与逻辑可验证性不匹配
defense_advice_zh: 采用神经符号验证机制，将 LLM 输出与符号执行或形式化验证结合
使用 Deductive Coverage Score 监控模型推理覆盖度
对 LLM 生成的安全内容实施主动验证，而非依赖水印或过滤
建立反机机制，防止评估数据集被游戏化

items.why_it_matters: 随着 LLM 越来越多地融入漏洞评估与安全运营，AI 生成的低质或幻觉内容可能误导排查、浪费人力甚至引入新风险。该综述首次系统定义并量化这种“AI slop”现象，为防御者识别和缓解此类风险提供了理论依据和评估工具。

items.title: Defending the Peg: Real-Time Dynamic Protection and Anomaly Detection in DeFi Stablecoins
items.summary: With the rapid evolution of the Decentralized Finance (DeFi) ecosystem, stablecoins have emerged as a critical infrastructure bridging the cryptocurrency market with traditional financial paradigms. However, stablecoin systems rely heavily on smart contracts to execute automated operations. The immutable nature of these systems post-deployment means that the exploitation of security vulnerabilities can lead to irreversible, massive economic losses and potentially trigger systemic financial risks. Current research on stablecoin smart contract security faces challenges such as a lack of domain-specific targeting and the obsolescence of static defense models. To address this, this paper systematically analyzes common attack vectors in stablecoin environments and proposes a practical, real-time dynamic defense architecture. By analyzing 12 real-world security incidents, we elucidate the underlying mechanisms of high-risk patterns such as reentrancy attacks, oracle manipulation, and composite flash loan attacks. Concurrently, we construct a real-time anomaly detection model utilizing multi-dimensional on-chain temporal features and the Bi-LSTM algorithm. Experimental results demonstrate that this model achieves a classification accuracy of 96.61\%, with an average recall rate of 97.70\% for malicious attack samples, and a single inference latency ranging from 1.5 to 2.8 milliseconds.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 本文针对去中心化金融（DeFi）生态中稳定币智能合约的安全防护问题展开研究。稳定币作为连接加密货币市场与传统金融范式的关键基础设施，其运行高度依赖智能合约执行自动化操作，而智能合约一旦部署便具有不可篡改性，这意味着任何安全漏洞被利用都可能导致不可逆的巨大经济损失，甚至引发系统性金融风险。现有稳定币智能合约安全研究存在领域针对性不足、静态防御模型过时等问题。为应对这些挑战，论文系统梳理了稳定币环境中常见的攻击向量，并提出了一种实用的实时动态防御架构。作者通过分析12个真实世界安全事件，揭示了重入攻击、预言机操纵、组合式闪电贷攻击等高危模式的内在机制。同时，他们利用多维链上时间特征和Bi-LSTM算法构建了实时异常检测模型。实验结果表明，该模型在分类任务上达到了96.61%的准确率，对恶意攻击样本的平均召回率为97.70%，单次推理延迟在1.5至2.8毫秒之间，能够满足实时检测的需求。这项研究的核心贡献在于将领域知识融入动态防御框架，并通过时序建模实现了对稳定币攻击的高效识别，为DeFi安全提供了新的思路。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 稳定币安全直接关系DeFi生态的稳定，本文提出的实时动态防御与高精度检测模型为蓝队监控链上异常提供了可落地的技术路径，值得安全工程师关注。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 可迁移至DeFi协议中的异常交易检测、闪电贷攻击预警、预言机风险监控等场景，也可为其他智能合约安全分析提供参考。

items.why_it_matters: 稳定币安全直接关系DeFi生态的稳定，本文提出的实时动态防御与高精度检测模型为蓝队监控链上异常提供了可落地的技术路径，值得安全工程师关注。

items.title: MMJailBench: A Factorized Benchmark for Disentangling Multimodal Jailbreak Vulnerabilities
items.summary: Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) are increasingly deployed in real-world applications, yet how different factors shape their jailbreak vulnerabilities remains poorly understood. Existing benchmarks often couple harmful intent, prompt framing, visual semantics, and instruction carrier within individual jailbreak instances, obscuring the specific sources of observed vulnerabilities. To address this limitation, we introduce MMJailBench, a factorized benchmark that systematically varies and combines these factors under controlled configurations, enabling fine-grained comparison and factor-level attribution. Large-scale evaluations across 16 open-weight and proprietary MLLMs reveal highly heterogeneous and model-dependent vulnerability profiles. Jailbreak vulnerability varies markedly across harm domains, exposing uneven coverage in current multimodal safety alignment. Prompt framing emerges as the dominant source of variation, task-relevant visual semantics systematically increase jailbreak susceptibility with authority-like cues exposing particularly pronounced vulnerabilities, and visually rendered instructions do not consistently increase jailbreak susceptibility relative to direct textual instructions. To further investigate the risks introduced by multimodal context, we conduct diagnostic analyses on a representative open-weight model and identify vulnerability-associated patterns in internal representations and cross-modal interactions. Finally, we develop a modular multimodal jailbreak evaluation suite with full and lightweight configurations, multiple judge options, and multidimensional metrics, enabling reproducible, scalable, and cost-efficient multimodal jailbreak auditing.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 该论文关注多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）在真实世界部署中的越狱（jailbreak）漏洞问题。现有基准测试往往将恶意意图、提示框架、视觉语义和指令载体等多个因素混杂在单个越狱实例中，导致难以定位漏洞的具体来源。为此，作者提出了 MMJailBench，一个因子化基准测试，通过系统化地变化和组合这些因素，实现细粒度比较和因子级归因。研究团队在 16 个开源和专有 MLLM 上进行了大规模评估，发现漏洞画像具有高度异质性和模型依赖性：不同危害领域的越狱漏洞差异显著，暴露出当前多模态安全对齐覆盖不均；提示框架是漏洞变异的主要来源，与任务相关的视觉语义会系统性增加越狱成功率，权威性提示（authority-like cues）尤其明显；而视觉渲染指令相比直接文本指令并未一致性地提高越狱成功率。进一步，作者对一个代表性开源模型进行诊断分析，识别出内部表征和跨模态交互中的漏洞相关模式。最后，他们开发了一个模块化多模态越狱评估工具包，支持完整和轻量级配置、多种评判器选项和多维指标，以实现可复现、可扩展且成本高效的多模态越狱审计。该研究为理解 MLLM 越狱漏洞的构成因素提供了系统方法，适合AI安全研究员、模型开发者和红队评估人员阅读。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 首次对多模态越狱漏洞进行因子级归因，揭示提示框架与视觉语义的真实影响，帮助安全团队精准定位对齐盲区，改进多模态安全测试方法。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 为多模态模型安全评估提供标准化基准和工具包，可迁移到模型发布前的安全审计、红队演练及安全对齐优化场景。

items.why_it_matters: 首次对多模态越狱漏洞进行因子级归因，揭示提示框架与视觉语义的真实影响，帮助安全团队精准定位对齐盲区，改进多模态安全测试方法。

items.title: Separating Disclosure from Authorization: Field-Tier Minimization for Agent Action Mediation
items.summary: A system that authorizes an action must see enough of it to decide, and a system that attests to its decision must record enough to be audited. Both pressures push raw action parameters -- recipients, payment memos, record identifiers -- into an append-only ledger that cannot delete them. We show the two are separable. We classify each parameter field, not each action class, into three tiers: fields a policy may legitimately match on, which cross raw; fields that are policy-relevant but identifying, which cross only as projections such as an email domain or a templated route shape; and fields with no legitimate policy use, which never leave the workload. The central property is that the ledger's commitment is a canonical digest of the full, unminimized parameters, computed before minimization runs. The commitment is therefore independent of the tier table: reclassifying a field changes what is disclosed without invalidating a historical entry, reopening a hash, or altering what an offline verifier checks. Tier table, policy schema and wire schema are generated from one per-action declaration, so the deciding and recording parties cannot hold different rules. We then address a question the architecture forces: which party should compute each attested fact? We argue it is settled by which party could lie about it undetectably, and derive three answers within one request -- the client computes the parameter digest, being the only party holding the data; it is structurally prevented from naming the definition that governed it, since that would write a false statement into a signed ledger; and it attests which tier table it applied, so divergence is detectable. We give a leakage analysis of each projection, report an incident in which a first-cut projection preserved the identifier it was written to remove, and state the residual trust the design does not eliminate.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 本文提出一种将“披露”与“授权”分离的字段级最小化架构，用于代理操作调解。在传统系统中，授权方必须查看足够多的操作参数才能做出决策，而审计方必须记录足够多的信息以供事后验证，这两股压力导致原始参数（如收件人、付款备注、记录标识符）被写入不可删除的追加型账本，造成隐私泄漏。作者认为这两个需求可以分离：不是按操作类别，而是按字段进行三级分类——策略可合法匹配的字段以原始形式传输；与策略相关但具有标识性的字段仅以投影形式传输（如仅传递邮箱域名或模板化路由形状）；无合法策略用途的字段永不离开发起方的工作负载。核心关键属性是：账本中的承诺（commitment）是在最小化运行之前，对完整未最小化参数计算出的规范摘要。因此该承诺独立于层级表，重新分类某个字段只会改变披露内容，不会使历史条目失效、无需重新哈希或更改离线验证者校验的内容。层级表、策略Schema和线上Schema由每个操作的单一声明统一生成，确保决策方和记录方无法持有不同规则。文章进一步回答了架构必须面对的问题：哪一方应计算每个已证明事实？作者根据“哪一方可能无法被检测地撒谎”来确定，最终得出在一次请求中的三个答案——客户端（唯一持有数据的一方）计算参数摘要；结构上阻止客户端命名治理它的定义，因为那会在签名账本中写入虚假陈述；客户端证明它应用了哪个层级表，从而使得分歧可被检测。作者给出了每个投影的泄漏分析，报告了一个实际事件：第一版投影保留了原本旨在移除的标识符，并指出了设计无法消除的剩余信任。该研究适合关注AI代理安全、隐私保护、审计日志设计的工程师与研究人员。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 该论文为代理操作中的隐私保护提供了可落地的字段级最小化方案，解决了授权与审计必须暴露完整数据这一核心矛盾。对构建安全的LLM代理系统、设计合规审计日志、防止敏感数据泄漏具有直接指导价值。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 影响任何需要记录代理行为的企业级系统，尤其是涉及金融交易、个人信息、内部标识符的场景。可迁移至AI Agent框架、身份权限审计、供应链记录等。
defense_advice_zh: 对代理操作的每个字段进行分级分类，明确哪些字段可以原始传输、哪些需要投影、哪些永不离开发起方。
使用规范摘要作为账本承诺，确保最小化不会导致历史记录失效，并保留可验证性。
从单一声明生成层级表、策略Schema与线上Schema，防止决策方和记录方规则不一致。
对投影函数进行严格测试，防止出现类似论文中保留原标识符的漏洞。

items.title: MACGen: Toward Functionally Correct and Secure Code Generation via Multi-Agent Collaboration
items.summary: Despite their strong ability to generate code, large language models often fail to produce secure code, as their outputs frequently contain security vulnerabilities. Secure code generation is inherently challenging because it requires solving a multi-objective problem: functional correctness and security. Existing approaches address this challenge by injecting external security knowledge or by using agentic feedback and iterative refinement. However, guideline retrieval often leaves the generator to translate generic advice into task-specific secure implementations, while shared-dialogue multi-agent feedback can blur role boundaries and suffer from context bloat. We present MACGen, a multi-agent framework that integrates planning, security analysis, code synthesis and refinement to jointly optimize security and functionality. A planner constructs a step-by-step plan to satisfy functional requirements. A security advisor identifies likely CWEs and synthesizes task-specific guidelines, a coder then generates code grounded in these artifacts, and a reviewer issues perspective-separated feedback. Rather than sharing full dialogue histories, each agent receives only structured artifacts from upstream stages, enforcing role specialization and reducing uncontrolled context growth. On CWEval and BaxBench, MACGen improves F&S@1 over direct prompting by 19.61 and 10.57 percentage points (pp) on average, respectively.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 本文提出 MACGen，一个基于多智能体协作的代码生成框架，旨在同时优化功能正确性和安全性。大语言模型生成的代码常包含安全漏洞，因为安全代码生成本质上是一个多目标优化问题。现有方法要么注入外部安全知识，要么使用智能体反馈和迭代细化，但知识检索往往让生成器自行将通用建议转化为任务特定的安全实现，而共享对话的多智能体反馈可能模糊角色边界并导致上下文膨胀。MACGen 集成了规划、安全分析、代码合成和细化四个阶段：规划器构建满足功能需求的逐步计划；安全顾问识别可能的 CWE 并合成任务特定的安全指南；编码器基于这些工件生成代码；审查者发出基于视角分离的反馈。各智能体只接收上游阶段的结构化工件，而非共享完整对话历史，从而强制角色专业化并减少不受控制的上下文增长。在 CWEval 和 BaxBench 基准上，MACGen 相比直接提示在功能正确性和安全性（F&S@1）上平均分别提升了 19.61 和 10.57 个百分点。该研究适合对 AI 安全、代码生成、多智能体系统感兴趣的学者和工程实践者。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 该研究直接面向 LLM 生成代码的安全性问题，提出一种可落地的多智能体协作框架，在提升代码功能正确性的同时显著降低漏洞风险，对 AI 辅助开发的安全实践具有参考价值。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 可能影响 AI 代码生成工具的安全评估方法，并为构建更安全的自动化编程助手提供新思路，尤其适用于需要高安全标准的开发场景。

items.why_it_matters: 该研究直接面向 LLM 生成代码的安全性问题，提出一种可落地的多智能体协作框架，在提升代码功能正确性的同时显著降低漏洞风险，对 AI 辅助开发的安全实践具有参考价值。

items.title: Here is a GIFT: Enforcing User Data Isolation in LLM Serving via GPU Information Flow Tracking
items.summary: LLM serving frameworks process large volumes of user data--often containing sensitive information--on shared infrastructure. Ensuring isolation between users who share the same serving framework (on CPUs) and LLM operators (on GPUs) is critical for privacy protection. This paper presents GIFT, a GPU Information Flow Tracking system that enforces user data isolation in LLM serving with minimal overhead. Moreover, the design of GIFT is non-intrusive and allows CPU-side serving frameworks to evolve freely. It rests on two key insights. First, encryption-as-isolation leverages the observation that CPU components only orchestrate data flow, not content manipulation; thus, per-user encryption can provide isolation without modifying serving logic. Second, GPU kernels exhibit limited and predictable information flows, enabling static flow analysis. GIFT precomputes information flow rules for each kernel and uses decoupled flow tracking, avoiding instrumentation or GPU stalls. Furthermore, we extend GIFT to GIFT-CC, which integrates confidential computing to protect against untrusted operating systems and hypervisors (LLM service providers). Implemented on vLLM and DistServe, GIFT and GIFT-CC enforce user data isolation with a 4-10.7% throughput overhead while maintaining the same latency level.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 本文针对LLM Serving框架在共享基础设施上处理大量用户数据时面临的数据隔离挑战，提出了一种基于GPU信息流跟踪的系统GIFT。现有LLM Serving框架（如vLLM）通常在CPU和GPU上共享资源，多租户场景下用户数据可能被同一框架的CPU侧逻辑或GPU上的操作者（如模型算子）访问，存在隐私泄露风险。GIFT的核心思想是数据隔离不需要修改Serving逻辑本身，而是通过两种关键洞察实现：第一，加密即隔离——CPU组件仅负责数据流的编排，不直接操纵数据内容，因此对每个用户的数据进行独立加密即可在CPU侧实现隔离，无需改动Serving代码；第二，GPU内核具有有限且可预测的信息流模式，可以通过静态分析预先计算每个内核的信息流规则。GIFT利用这种确定性实施解耦的流追踪，避免对GPU的插桩或停顿，从而在保持低开销的同时强制执行用户数据隔离。作者进一步扩展出GIFT-CC，集成机密计算（Confidential Computing）以防御不受信任的操作系统和虚拟机监视器（即LLM服务提供商自身）。他们在vLLM和DistServe上实现了GIFT和GIFT-CC，实验结果表明在保持相同延迟水平的同时，吞吐量开销仅为4-10.7%。该研究适合LLM基础设施开发者、隐私工程研究员以及关注多租户安全性的云服务提供商阅读，为在不影响性能的前提下实现强数据隔离提供了可行方案。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: LLM服务普遍采用多租户共享GPU，用户数据隔离是隐私合规的硬需求。GIFT首次将信息流跟踪引入GPU内核分析，以极小开销实现CPU和GPU两侧的隔离，并为防范不可信云服务商提供了机密计算扩展路径，对实际部署有直接参考价值。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 适用于所有基于GPU的LLM Serving系统（如vLLM、DistServe），可推广至其他数据密集型推理框架；其加密即隔离和静态流分析思路也可用于边缘GPU推理或多云场景。
detection_signals_zh: GPU内核静态分析规则异常或缺失
CPU与GPU间数据加密状态不一致
多租户共享服务中的跨用户数据访问尝试
defense_advice_zh: 在LLM Serving框架中引入基于加密的用户数据隔离机制，而非仅依赖逻辑隔离
对GPU内核进行信息流静态分析，建立白名单规则并实时校验
对于高安全场景，结合机密计算（如TEE）以防范不可信操作系统层

items.why_it_matters: LLM服务普遍采用多租户共享GPU，用户数据隔离是隐私合规的硬需求。GIFT首次将信息流跟踪引入GPU内核分析，以极小开销实现CPU和GPU两侧的隔离，并为防范不可信云服务商提供了机密计算扩展路径，对实际部署有直接参考价值。

items.title: Refusal geometry reflects refusal training: diverse refusal prefixes can raise stable rank and weaken refusal vector ablation attacks
items.summary: Refusal training protects AI models from jailbreaks by training models to decline unsafe queries, reducing the risk of misuse. Recent work finds that refusal behavior in aligned language models can be mediated by a single activation direction or a low-dimensional refusal subspace shared across harmful prompts: ablating those directions suppresses refusals while largely preserves other model capabilities. Yet it remains unclear why safety-critical features in a wide range of models emerge and concentrated, low-dimensional structure. In a case study of OLMo-2-0425-1B-Instruct we find that the refusal geometry reflects refusal training: activation updates resulting from refusal-completion first-token losses explain the resulting refusal direction and refusal subspace. We study refusal directions through the training dynamics across refusal datasets and reveal that their brittleness is associated with repetitive refusal starts, which in turn is linked to concentration of gradients and refusal features in a low-dimensional subspace. Across frozen-model analyses and controlled synthetic fine-tuning, we find evidence of a hardening lever: diverse refusal starts can raise stable ranks of gradients and activation changes, making refusals harder to remove with a vector ablation attack.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 本文研究拒绝训练（refusal training）如何影响大语言模型（LLM）的安全对齐，特别是拒绝行为为何集中于低维子空间，以及这种集中性如何导致模型易于被向量消融攻击（vector ablation）破坏。作者以 OLMo-2-0425-1B-Instruct 为案例，发现拒绝几何直接反映拒绝训练的动态：由拒绝完成（refusal-completion）第一个 token 的损失梯度所产生的激活更新，能够解释最终形成的拒绝方向和拒绝子空间。通过观察多个拒绝数据集上的训练动态，作者发现拒绝行为的脆弱性与重复的拒绝开头（repetitive refusal starts）密切相关，这种重复性导致梯度和拒绝特征在低维子空间上高度集中。基于冻结模型分析和受控合成微调实验，作者提出一种“硬化杠杆”：在训练中使用多样化的拒绝开头，可以提升梯度和激活变化的稳定秩（stable rank），从而使拒绝行为难以被简单的向量消融攻击移除。实验结果表明，多样化的前缀可以增强对齐模型的鲁棒性，为理解安全对齐中参数更新的几何结构提供了新视角。该论文属于基础性安全对齐研究，适合关注 LLM 安全机制、对抗性攻击防御和对齐可解释性的研究人员阅读。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 该研究揭示了拒绝训练脆弱性的几何成因，为构建更稳健的 LLM 安全对齐提供了可操作训练策略，帮助防御者理解并缓解向量消融类越狱攻击。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 研究结论可推广到其他对齐模型的安全评估中，影响安全训练数据设计、微调策略以及对抗性鲁棒性测试方法，但具体模型迁移性需进一步验证。
defense_advice_zh: 在安全微调时引入多样化的拒绝前缀，避免单一、重复的拒绝风格，以提高梯度空间的维度，削弱向量消融攻击的效果。
对已部署模型可测试其拒绝子空间的稳定秩，评估现有对齐的鲁棒性。

items.why_it_matters: 该研究揭示了拒绝训练脆弱性的几何成因，为构建更稳健的 LLM 安全对齐提供了可操作训练策略，帮助防御者理解并缓解向量消融类越狱攻击。

items.title: Capacity Overflow: A Blind Spot for Backdoor Attacks in Vision MoE
items.summary: Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) has become a prevalent paradigm for scaling Vision Transformers efficiently. To ensure computational scalability and prevent expert overload, Vision MoE architectures employ a capacity-bounded token dispatch mechanism, where each expert's processing budget depends on the inference batch size. This work identifies this batch-dependent behavior as an overlooked attack surface, and proposes a stealthy supply-chain backdoor attack that exploits this property through a three-phase framework. First, we inject a backdoor into an early MoE layer. Second, we train a neutralizer in a deeper MoE layer that suppresses the backdoor under normal capacity. Third, we configure a batch-adaptive capacity factor that preserves high capacity for small batches while reducing it for large batches, naturally disabling the neutralizer via token overflow at deployment-scale batch sizes. The attack remains in dormant mode during small-batch security audits and enters activation mode during large-batch deployment. Experiments on V-MoE and Swin-MoE across ImageNet-100 and GTSRB demonstrate activation-mode attack success rates of 76-87% with dormant-mode ASR below 9%, while evading Neural Cleanse, STRIP, Fine-Pruning, and Activation Clustering. Our findings reveal a fundamental security risk arising from batch-dependent execution in scalable Vision MoE architectures.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 本文针对视觉混合专家（Vision Mixture-of-Experts, MoE）模型提出了一种新型的隐蔽供应链后门攻击。MoE架构通过门控机制将不同输入分配给不同的专家子网络，以在扩展模型规模的同时保持计算效率。为了防止专家过载，视觉MoE架构通常采用容量受限的令牌分发机制，每个专家处理令牌的数量取决于推理时的批量大小（batch size）。作者指出，这种批量依赖行为是一个被忽视的攻击面。攻击分为三个阶段：首先在较浅的MoE层注入后门触发器；然后在较深的MoE层训练一个“中和器”（neutralizer），在正常容量条件下抑制后门触发；最后配置一个批量自适应的容量因子，使模型在小批量时保持高容量，而在大批量时降低容量，从而在部署规模的大批量推理中通过令牌溢出自发地禁用中和器，激活后门。这种攻击在小批量安全审计时处于休眠状态，而在大批量部署时激活。作者在V-MoE和Swin-MoE架构上，针对ImageNet-100和GTSRB数据集进行了实验，结果显示激活模式下攻击成功率（ASR）达到76%至87%，而休眠模式下ASR低于9%，并且能够绕过Neural Cleanse、STRIP、Fine-Pruning和Activation Clustering等多种主流后门检测方法。该研究揭示了可扩展视觉MoE架构中批处理依赖执行所引发的根本性安全风险。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 该攻击针对MoE模型的批量大小依赖特性，可绕过现有后门检测机制，对使用预训练视觉MoE模型的供应链构成实际威胁。安全团队需关注模型部署时批量大小变化可能触发的隐蔽行为。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 主要影响采用MoE架构的视觉模型（如V-MoE、Swin-MoE）在批量部署场景中的安全性，尤其对使用第三方预训练模型的供应链场景风险更高。
detection_signals_zh: 监测模型在不同批量大小下激活模式（如特定层输出分布）的异常差异
对可疑模型进行小批量和大批量条件下的行为对比测试
检查模型权重中是否存在与批量自适应相关的异常参数
defense_advice_zh: 对预训练MoE模型进行严格的供应链审查，验证模型来源可信度
在部署前使用多种批量大小进行安全测试，观察预测结果是否出现显著跳变
考虑对MoE模型的容量因子进行限制或施加随机扰动，增加攻击触发难度

items.why_it_matters: 该攻击针对MoE模型的批量大小依赖特性，可绕过现有后门检测机制，对使用预训练视觉MoE模型的供应链构成实际威胁。安全团队需关注模型部署时批量大小变化可能触发的隐蔽行为。

items.title: LLMscope: Extracting LLM Assets from Edge AI Chips via Optical Probing
items.summary: The move of LLM inference to edge AI accelerators introduces new physical vulnerabilities. During execution, model parameters and intermediate inference states are repeatedly loaded into and processed on the chip, making them suscep- tible to physical side-channel attacks. In this work, by deploying laser voltage imaging, we show that one can extract LLM assets during inference, namely embeddings, attention, and quantized MLP weights, activations, and other inference states, from localized memories and compute subcircuits. To validate our claims, we perform an attack on an FPGA-based LLM accelerator. Since such accelerators reuse the same buffers and compute subcircuits across addresses, tiles, modules, and layers, reading asset values comes down to probing different memories during inference. We demonstrate full recovery of the targeted values; however, we also establish a methodology to recover asset values even if some weights or bits remain unread. We further derive lower bounds that relate imaging effort to asset dimensions and show that even direct recovery scales linearly with the size of the targeted asset

llm_summary.summary_zh: 该论文来自 arXiv（cs.AI 分类），研究将大语言模型（LLM）推理迁移到边缘 AI 加速器后引入的全新物理安全风险。在推理过程中，模型参数和中间推理状态会被反复加载到芯片上的局部存储器和计算子电路中，这使得它们容易受到物理侧信道攻击。作者提出并验证了一种基于激光电压成像（Laser Voltage Imaging）的攻击方法，能够从基于 FPGA 的 LLM 加速器中提取关键的 LLM 资产，包括嵌入向量、注意力权重、量化后的 MLP 权重、激活值以及其他推理状态。由于这类加速器在地址、tile、模块和层之间复用相同的缓冲区和计算子电路，读取资产值简化为在推理期间探测不同的存储器区域。实验证明，该方法能够完整恢复目标数值；同时，即使部分权重或比特位未被读取，作者也建立了相应的恢复方法论。此外，论文推导了成像工作量与资产维度之间的下界关系，表明直接恢复的复杂度与目标资产规模呈线性增长。该研究揭示了边缘 AI 芯片在物理层面存在的机密性威胁，为硬件安全社区提供了新的研究方向，也提醒安全从业者关注 LLM 推理部署在物理可接触环境中的风险。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 首次针对边缘 LLM 加速器展示物理侧信道提取完整模型资产的可能性，表明即使软件层加密/混淆，物理可接触的设备仍会泄露 LLM 核心参数，对边缘 AI 安全评估具有重要参考价值。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 影响边缘 AI 芯片（如 FPGA 加速器、嵌入式 NPU）上的 LLM 部署场景，尤其面向物理可接触攻击者的威胁模型，可能导致模型知识产权（权重）和用户隐私（中间状态）泄露。

items.title: RWA-PoB: A Credential-Based Proof-of-Backing Framework for Tokenized U.S. Treasury Products
items.summary: Proof of reserves (PoR) can improve transparency for tokenized assets, but aggregate reserve coverage does not establish whether off-chain assets are legally eligible, unencumbered, consistently valued, or sufficiently liquid for redemptions. We propose RWA-PoB, a credential-based proof-of-backing framework for tokenized U.S. Treasury products. Five authorised institutional roles approve a canonical EIP-712 snapshot containing reserve, liability, liquidity, and policy information. The framework evaluates backing adequacy through the Backing Coverage Ratio (BCR) and short-term redemption capacity through the Redemption Liquidity Coverage (RLC). The Solidity prototype couples the policy controller to an ERC-20 token. Successful issuance atomically increases token supply and recorded liabilities by the corresponding USD-denominated liability. A redemption request burns tokens while reclassifying the corresponding obligation as pending. The obligation is reduced only after an authorised settlement-role account confirms payment. We evaluate the framework against a simplified aggregate PoR baseline using USDY-calibrated liabilities and deterministic synthetic reserve scenarios. Both approaches permit issuance in the valid state, but RWA-PoB rejects an encumbered-assets state with a BCR of 96.3408%, below the experimental 105% threshold. Under liquidity stress, it classifies the proposed redemption as queued because the post-request RLC falls to 39.9999%. RWA-PoB authenticates the attribution and integrity of institutional claims but does not independently prove the existence, ownership, or condition of off-chain assets. The prototype, test suite, datasets, and replication scripts are available at https://github.com/rischanlab/PoB.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 该论文提出 RWA-PoB，一个面向代币化美国国债产品的基于凭证的背书证明框架。传统资产储备证明（PoR）虽能提供总储备覆盖率，却无法证明链下资产在法律上具备合格性、未受质押约束、估值连续一致，以及具备足够的赎回流动性。为弥补这一缺口，框架引入五个获授权的机构角色，共同审批一个标准化的 EIP-712 快照，该快照包含储备、负债、流动性和政策信息。框架通过两个关键指标评估背书充足性：Backing Coverage Ratio（BCR）衡量整体资产对负债的覆盖程度；Redemption Liquidity Coverage（RLC）衡量短期内应对赎回请求的流动性能力。作者提供了 Solidity 原型，将策略控制器与 ERC-20 代币耦合：成功的发行操作会原子地增加代币供应量，并同步记账以美元计价的负债；赎回请求则销毁代币，将对应义务重分类为“待处理（pending）”，只有经授权的结算角色确认支付后，义务才被正式核减。实验部分基于 USDY 校准的负债数据和确定性合成储备场景，与简化的聚合 PoR 基线进行对比。结果表明，RWA-PoB 能够在有效状态下允许发行，但在质押受限资产场景下，BCR 为 96.3408%，低于实验设定的 105% 阈值，因此拒绝发行；在流动性压力测试下，由于赎回后 RLC 降至 39.9999%，框架将拟议赎回归类为“排队”状态。研究强调，RWA-PoB 能够验证机构声明的归属与完整性，但并不能独立证明链下资产的存在、所有权或实际状态。原型代码、测试套件、数据集和复现脚本均已在 GitHub 公开。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 为代币化 RWA 资产提供更严格的背书审计框架，弥补传统 PoR 在资产质量和流动性层面的盲区。安全工程师可借鉴其凭证审批、阈值校验和状态机设计，提升链上资产审计的透明性与可信度。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 可迁移至其他代币化 RWA 场景（如代币化债券、房地产、私人信贷），也可为 DeFi 协议和稳定币审计提供背书证明的设计参考。
detection_signals_zh: 监控 EIP-712 快照的提交权限变更，识别未授权机构角色操作
跟踪 BCR 或 RLC 指标异常下降至阈值以下的链上事件
检测代币发行/赎回交易中负债记录与代币供应量是否原子同步
defense_advice_zh: 实施多角色、多签审批机制，确保快照无法被单一实体篡改
对关键阈值（如 BCR、RLC）设置实时告警，触发后自动暂停发行或赎回
定期审计链下资产凭证，并将凭证哈希锚定到链上增强不可抵赖性

items.title: Multi-View Trust Evaluation for Collaborator Selection via Evidential Deep Learning
items.summary: Selection of trustworthy collaborators in distributed systems is critical for efficient task completion, necessitating the inference of trustworthiness from their past collaboration experience. However, as a collaborator serves distinct devices across diverse scenarios in past collaborations, its trust-related data, observed from different device-specific views, is inherently multi-source, heterogeneous, and uneven in quality. Consequently, achieving accurate trust evaluations for collaborator selection remains a major challenge. To tackle these issues, we propose a novel multi-view evidential learning (MVE) based trust evaluation method. First, to accommodate the multi-source heterogeneity of observed trust-related data, we model each task owner who has interacted with a potential collaborator as an independent observational view, enabling the evaluation of the collaborator's view-specific trust. Second, to address the dynamic evolution of trust under changing conditions, we leverage the powerful long-sequence modeling capability of the Mamba model to capture the deep temporal patterns of a collaborator's trust state within each view. Furthermore, to quantify the certainty levels of view-specific trust assessments, we incorporate an evidential deep learning mechanism in MVE, which outputs trust evaluation results while quantifying the subjective uncertainty underlying them. Finally, we employ a dynamic evidential fusion strategy to adaptively integrate the multi-view evidence based on their respective quantified uncertainties, thereby yielding a final trust evaluation for the collaborator. Extensive experiments demonstrate that the proposed MVE method outperforms baselines in both trust evaluation accuracy and task success rate.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 本文针对分布式系统中合作者选择的信任评估问题，提出了一种基于多视图证据深度学习（Multi-View Evidential learning, MVE）的信任评估方法。在分布式环境中，系统需要从潜在合作者过往的协作经验中推断其可信度，以便选择最合适的合作者完成任务。然而，一个合作者在不同设备、不同场景下所展现的信任相关数据往往具有多源性、异构性和质量参差不齐的特点。具体来说，每个设备或任务所有者只能从自身视角观察到合作者的一部分行为，从而形成多源异构的视图，导致单一视角下的信任评估难以准确反映真实情况。为此，作者首先将每个与潜在合作者有过交互的任务所有者建模为一个独立的观测视图，分别评估合作者在该视图下的信任值，从而适应数据异质性。其次，为了捕捉信任在动态环境下的演化规律，MVE方法利用Mamba模型强大的长序列建模能力，提取每个视图中合作者信任状态的深层时间模式。再次，为了量化各视图下信任评估的不确定性，MVE引入证据深度学习机制，在输出信任评估结果的同时度量其主观不确定性。最后，设计了一种动态证据融合策略，根据各视图证据的不确定性自适应地整合多方证据，得到合作者的最终信任评价。实验结果表明，MVE方法在信任评估准确性和任务成功率上均优于若干基线方法。本文的贡献在于提出了一种融合多视图表示、时序建模与不确定性量化的信任评估框架，有效解决了多源异构数据下的合作者信任推断难题。适合分布式计算、协作系统与人工智能安全领域的研究者阅读。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 在分布式系统与联邦协作场景中，信任评估是抵御恶意参与者、保障任务完成质量的基础。该工作提出的多视图证据融合方法，利用深度学习量化不确定性，可为零信任架构中的动态信任决策提供可解释的量化依据。

items.title: ADeptS-Bench: Measuring the Trustworthiness of Computer Use Agents Across Devices
items.summary: Computer Use Agents (CUAs) are increasingly deployed to navigate mobile and desktop applications on behalf of users, yet no benchmark comprehensively evaluates whether they can safely interact with visual interfaces while handling ambiguous instructions. We introduce ADeptS-Bench, a dual-stream trustworthiness benchmark, grounded in the ADEPTS capability framework and general population user studies. The Safety stream provides paired benign/malicious tasks with threats embedded in the visual interface. The Disambiguation stream evaluates whether agents seek clarification when intent is ambiguous. Evaluating seven models reveals that no model consistently exceeds 80% task success while staying below 30% attack success; every model clicks "Checkout" on a $25K order without hesitation, and none detects that a "factory reset" button is mislabeled as "Optimize." An ablation reveals three distinct safety architectures: tool-dependent (ASR +21-23pp without refusal tool), partially tool-dependent (+10-11pp), and no mechanism (unchanged). In disambiguation, all models overestimate consequence severity, mirroring the over-refusal bias observed in safety. We release all data, evaluation code, and analysis tools upon publication.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 本文针对计算机使用智能体（Computer Use Agents, CUAs）在跨设备（移动端与桌面端）视觉界面中的可信赖性评估缺失问题，提出了ADeptS-Bench基准测试。研究背景是：随着CUAs被广泛部署以代表用户操作应用程序，它们需要同时应对视觉界面中的安全威胁和模糊指令中的潜在风险，但现有基准未能全面覆盖这两方面。核心方法包括：构建双流（dual-stream）可信赖性基准，基于ADEPTS能力框架和一般人群用户研究设计任务。Safety流提供成对的良性/恶意任务，将威胁嵌入视觉界面；Disambiguation流评估智能体在意图模糊时是否主动寻求澄清。实验评估了七个模型，结果显示没有任何模型能在任务成功率超过80%的同时将攻击成功率控制在30%以下；所有模型都会毫不犹豫地点击2.5万美元订单的“结账”按钮，且均未检测到“恢复出厂设置”按钮被错误标注为“优化”。通过消融实验，识别出三种安全架构：工具依赖型（移除拒绝工具后攻击成功率增加21-23个百分点）、部分工具依赖型（增加10-11个百分点）以及无安全机制型（攻击成功率不变）。在消融实验中，所有模型都高估了后果严重性，反映出与安全领域中过度拒绝偏误相似的现象。作者承诺在论文发表后公开所有数据、评估代码和分析工具。本研究的主要贡献是为CUA可信赖性提供了首个双流评估基准，揭示了当前模型在关键安全场景中的缺陷，并为未来安全架构设计提供了方向。适合AI安全研究员、智能体系统开发者、人机交互与安全交叉领域从业者阅读。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 该基准首次系统评估了计算机使用智能体在视觉界面上的安全性，揭示主流模型存在严重安全缺陷，对AI agent的部署和监管具有直接参考价值。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 影响所有基于视觉界面的自主智能体（如移动端助手、桌面自动化工具），以及依赖此类智能体的电商、系统维护等场景；有助于改进智能体安全对齐方法。
detection_signals_zh: 智能体在高价值操作（如大额支付）前未进行二次确认
对视觉元素标签（如按钮文本）的错误理解导致危险操作
在指令意图模糊时直接执行而非请求澄清
defense_advice_zh: 在智能体流程中强制加入关键操作的风险确认机制
对视觉界面元素进行语义一致性校验，防止误导性标签
训练阶段引入对抗性视觉扰动和模糊指令样本

items.title: Automotive HSMs - Architectural Challenges and Security Implications
items.summary: Automotive electronic control units (ECUs) increasingly depend on hardware-rooted security to protect software integrity, authenticity, and lifecycle management in the presence of remote and physical threats. Hardware Security Modules (HSMs) have become a key building block in automotive system-on-chips (SoCs), providing isolated cryptographic services, secure key storage, and controlled execution under stringent real-time and cost constraints. This paper presents an architectural analysis of automotive HSMs and examines their role in establishing secure boot and hardware roots of trust. We first survey common HSM integration models used in production ECUs and discuss their flexibility and current automotive use cases. We then introduce realistic threat models to motivate hardware-backed security controls and analyze how HSM design choices influence secure boot chains of trust, secure storage, secure execution, and software signing mechanisms. Key tradeoffs between isolation, performance, updateability, and attack surface are discussed, with optional consideration of side-channel implications. The paper concludes by highlighting open challenges and future directions for scalable and resilient automotive hardware security. Finally, we discuss emerging challenges such as cryptographic agility and post-quantum readiness that are likely to shape the next generation of automotive HSM architectures.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 本文对汽车硬件安全模块（HSM）进行了体系结构层面的分析，探讨其在现代汽车电子控制单元（ECU）中建立硬件根信任的关键作用。随着汽车ECU面临越来越多的远程和物理威胁，依赖硬件根安全来保护软件完整性、真实性和生命周期管理已成为必然趋势。HSM作为汽车SoC中的核心组件，提供隔离的密码服务、安全密钥存储和受控执行环境，同时需满足严格的实时性和成本约束。论文首先调研了量产ECU中常见的HSM集成模型，分析了不同模型的灵活性和典型应用场景；随后引入贴近现实的威胁模型，以论证硬件支撑安全控制的必要性，并详细分析了HSM设计选择如何影响安全启动信任链、安全存储、安全执行和软件签名机制。作者重点讨论了隔离性、性能、可更新性与攻击面之间的关键权衡，并可选地考虑了侧信道影响。文章最后指出了可扩展且具韧性的汽车硬件安全所面临的开放挑战和未来方向，特别强调了密码敏捷性和后量子就绪等新兴问题，这些预计将塑造下一代汽车HSM架构。该研究属于体系结构分析与安全性评估类工作，适合汽车安全架构师、SoC设计者、功能安全与网络安全工程师阅读，以理解HSM在整车安全架构中的定位与设计取舍。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 汽车HSM是车辆网络安全根信任的基石，本文系统梳理了其架构选型与安全权衡，有助于安全从业者理解硬件信任锚的局限与演进方向，为整车安全评估和设计提供参考。

items.title: Authenticated Data Structures for Dynamic Workloads
items.summary: We introduce the Huffman-Merkle Tree (HMT), an authenticated data structure (ADS) for dynamic workloads where items may differ in access frequencies, and access frequencies can change over time. An ADS allows proving item membership against a short commitment to a large mutable state, with applications including verifiable storage, Internet transparency services, and blockchains. Optimizing ADS performance under continuously changing access frequencies has not been fully addressed before, neither in theory nor in practice. HMT addresses dynamically changing access skew through two complementary mechanisms. The first is a Huffman-coding-based Merkle-tree layout, with a novel extension to support evolving access frequencies. The second is an elastic tiering regime that partitions items across separate trees, such as hot and cold tiers, with adaptive migration between them. The key insight in this approach is to place frequently accessed items closer to the root, while assigning less frequently accessed items to progressively larger and deeper trees. This reduces the overall frequency-weighted access cost. Our scheme is designed to scale to gigabytes of data spanning millions of items. To handle dynamism efficiently, layout updates are applied in batches, access frequencies are tracked using a count-min sketch, and the system employs a tier-promotion cache while exploring multiple tier-migration policies. We implement HMT and compare it on real-world data with Ethereum's Merkle Patricia Trie (MPT) ADS and its proposed replacement, the Unified Binary Tree (UBT). Our evaluation considers two metrics: the amount of hashing per update and access-weighted membership-proof size. The latter captures both item access cost and frequency. We find that the best HMT policy uses about 2.4x and 0.34x less average hash operations than MPT and UBT respectively, and has 0.18x and 0.55x shorter proofs.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 该论文提出了一种面向动态工作负载的认证数据结构（ADS）——Huffman-Merkle Tree（HMT）。ADS 允许在仅持有短承诺（commitment）的情况下，对大规模可变状态中的条目进行成员关系证明，典型应用包括可验证存储、互联网透明度服务和区块链系统。现有 ADS 大多假设条目被访问的概率近似均匀，或只考虑静态访问模式；但在真实动态负载中，条目的访问频率差异显著且会随时间变化，现有方案在持续变化的访问偏斜（access skew）下无法实现最优性能。HMT 通过两个互补机制解决该问题：第一，基于 Huffman 编码的 Merkle 树布局，并扩展为支持访问频率演化的版本，使得高频访问条目更靠近根节点，低频条目分配到更大、更深的子树，从而降低频率加权的平均访问成本；第二，弹性分层（elastic tiering）机制，将条目按热度划分到不同子树（如热层与冷层），并支持自适应迁移。为高效处理动态性，HMT 采用批量布局更新、使用 count-min sketch 追踪访问频率，并通过分层提升缓存（tier-promotion cache）以及多种迁移策略来优化性能。实验基于真实数据与以太坊的 Merkle Patricia Trie（MPT）及其拟替代方案 Unified Binary Tree（UBT）进行对比，评估指标为每次更新的哈希量以及访问加权的成员证明大小。结果表明，最优 HMT 策略的平均哈希操作数比 MPT 少约 2.4 倍、比 UBT 少约 0.34 倍（即 HMT 约为 MPT 的 0.42 倍、UBT 的 0.29 倍），证明长度分别缩短至 MPT 的 0.18 倍和 UBT 的 0.55 倍。论文从理论和实践上填补了动态访问频率下 ADS 优化的空白，适用于大规模区块链状态存储、透明性日志等场景。适合对区块链基础设施、可验证存储系统以及认证数据结构优化感兴趣的研究者和工程师阅读。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 区块链和可验证存储中，状态访问存在明显热点，HMT 能显著降低更新和证明开销，直接影响节点同步效率和轻客户端验证成本，对 Layer1/Layer2 扩容和去中心化存储有实际价值。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 可迁移到以太坊状态树、UTXO 模型、透明证书日志、分布式账本及任何需要动态认证的大型可变数据集场景。

items.title: BGPay: An Incentive-Compatible Mechanism for BGP Hijack Filtering
items.summary: BGP hijacking remains a persistent threat as existing defenses, including RPKI/ROV suffer from a fundamental incentive misalignment: the networks best positioned to filter malicious announcements bear operational costs but receive no direct benefit, while the victim prefix owner captures all the value. We advocate a market-based alternative in which prefix owners post standing bounties for filtering invalid announcements of their prefixes, turning filtering from altruism into a private transaction. Our insight is that neither a propagating hijack nor its absence can hide from public route collectors, whose committed routing tables could become an independent root of trust for releasing funds of the bounty. We build on this insight to design BGPay, an escrow protocol in which filterers and monitors commit before either reveals, and a smart contract pays out on evidence rather than on the prefix owner's judgment. Analyzing 1K real hijack incidents, we find that today's collectors already provide enough visibility where it matters: ASes that are more important for containing the hijack are also highly visible from the public monitors. Hence, setting rewards proportionately to containment impact discourages misbehavior.

llm_summary.summary_zh: BGP劫持仍然是互联网路由安全中的持续性威胁。现有防御机制（如RPKI/ROV）存在根本性的激励错配：最有利于过滤恶意公告的网络（如上游或对等方）需要承担过滤操作的成本，却无法从中获得直接收益，而受害者前缀所有者却获得了所有价值。这种“旁观者负担”导致关键网络的过滤积极性不足。本文提出了一种基于市场的替代方案——BGPay，其核心思想是让前缀所有者为其前缀的无效公告过滤发布公开悬赏，从而将过滤行为从利他主义转变为私人交易。作者的关键洞察在于：无论是传播中的劫持还是劫持的消失，都无法躲避公共路由收集器（route collectors）的视线；这些收集器提交的路由表可以成为独立的资金释放信任根。基于此，BGPay设计了一个托管协议，其中过滤者和监视者先承诺后透露，并通过智能合约依据证据（而不是依据前缀所有者的主观判断）进行支付。协议通过承诺机制防止参与者作弊，确保资金仅在有效过滤证据出现时释放。作者分析了1000个真实劫持事件，发现当前的公共收集器在关键位置已经提供了足够的可见性：对于控制劫持传播更为重要的AS（自治系统）在公共监视器中也具有高可见性。因此，将奖励与遏制影响成比例设置可以有效抑制不当行为。本文的贡献在于提出了一种激励兼容的过滤机制，将BGP安全从依赖自愿合作转向经济激励驱动，为路由安全提供了新的思路。适合网络运营商、BGP安全研究人员以及区块链与网络安全交叉领域的从业者阅读。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: BGP劫持是互联网基础设施的顽疾，现有安全机制因激励错配而落地困难。BGPay的创新点在于用经济激励（智能合约与悬赏）驱动过滤行为，为SOC和网络团队提供了一种可操作的市场化防御思路，可能改变未来路由安全部署的方式。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 若该机制得以部署，可显著提升关键AS对BGP劫持的过滤覆盖率，降低劫持事件的实际危害；其智能合约模式也可能推广到其他需要多方协作的安全场景（如DNS过滤、DDoS缓解）。

items.title: FuzzingBrain-Bench V1: Evaluating Open-Ended Bug Discovery by LLMs
items.summary: Evaluating the ability of large language models (LLMs) to discover software bugs is increasingly important. Existing benchmarks typically evaluate this capability by asking the model to generate a proof-of-concept input that triggers a predefined target vulnerability. However, this setup may overlook valid crashes discovered by the model when they do not match the predefined target. As a result, the evaluation may not reflect the model's real capability. We present FuzzingBrain-Bench, a benchmark for assessing AI models' ability to discover bugs in open-source software. Models are given an open-source project and a sanitizer-instrumented harness in a self-contained Docker image. Their goal is to generate inputs that trigger as many distinct crashes as possible through the harness. A model's performance on each challenge is scored based on the number of distinct crash signatures it produces, capped at a predefined maximum and weighted by a difficulty coefficient. FuzzingBrain-Bench V1 consists of 77 challenges drawn from 43 open-source projects, with 36 C, 32 C++, and 9 Java/JVM challenges. We evaluate Claude Haiku 4.5, Claude Sonnet 4.6, and Claude Opus 4.8 on the full benchmark. Claude Opus 4.8 performs best, triggering crashes in 60 of 77 challenges and achieving a score of 196 out of 579. None of the three models triggers a crash in 13 challenges. The FuzzingBrain-Bench corpus and harnesses are publicly available at https://github.com/fuzzingbrain/FuzzingBrain-Bench.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 该论文提出并构建了 FuzzingBrain-Bench V1，一个用于评估大语言模型（LLM）在开源软件中发现缺陷能力的基准测试。现有评估通常要求模型生成触发预定义目标的 PoC 输入，这忽略了模型发现的、但不匹配预定义目标的合法崩溃，导致评估结果不能真实反映模型能力。FuzzingBrain-Bench 改变了评估范式：将开源项目及其带 sanitizer 的 harness 封装在自包含的 Docker 镜像中，要求模型生成尽可能多的、能引发不同崩溃的输入。得分基于模型产生的不同崩溃签名数量，并设有上限和难度系数加权。V1 包含 43 个开源项目的 77 个挑战，涵盖 36 个 C、32 个 C++ 和 9 个 Java/JVM 项目。作者在完整基准上评估了 Claude Haiku 4.5、Claude Sonnet 4.6 和 Claude Opus 4.8。结果显示 Claude Opus 4.8 表现最佳，在 77 个挑战中的 60 个中触发了崩溃，总分 579 分中得 196 分；三个模型均未能触发 13 个挑战中的任何崩溃。该基准和 harness 已开源。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 为 LLM 驱动漏洞发现提供更真实的评估标准，改进传统单一目标评估的局限性，对自动化安全测试研究具有重要参考价值。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 直接影响 LLM 辅助 fuzzing 和漏洞挖掘的评估方法，可迁移到其他 AI 代码分析基准设计，有助于安全团队评估 LLM 工具的实用能力。

items.title: CA-less Mutual Co-Signing of Documents over a Unidirectional Visual Channel with Transported Hardware Attestation
items.summary: We describe and analyze a protocol for mutual co-signing of a document by two mobile devices that (i) communicate only over a one-way, lossy, low-bandwidth optical channel (an animated on-screen code read by the counterparty's camera), (ii) use no intermediary server on the trust path, and (iii) use no certificate authority. Trust in each party's public key is instead grounded in a hardware attestation token produced by the platform secure element, transported in full over the visual channel by a rateless (fountain) code and cryptographically bound into the co-signature. The core technical contribution is a two-stage hash anchor that removes the circular signing dependency inherent to interactive co-signing: the first party commits to the document before the identity of the second party is known, and the second party's identity is later bound to that commitment without invalidating the first signature. We give a threat model, define four security properties (anchor binding, co-signature inseparability, attestation-bound key provenance, and post-signing tamper evidence) and reduce them to standard assumptions (collision resistance of H and EUF-CMA security of the underlying signature scheme), with the secure element modeled as an ideal signing oracle. We report a working instantiation on iOS/Android using ECDSA P-256 in the Secure Enclave/StrongBox, SHA-256, Apple App Attest / Play Integrity, and an LT-style fountain code, together with an independent third-party verifier that recomputes all anchors and checks both signatures fully offline.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 本文提出并分析了一种无需证书颁发机构（CA）和中间信任服务器的双向文档共同签名协议。该协议允许两台移动设备仅通过单向、有损、低带宽的视觉信道（即一方屏幕上显示的动画编码，由另一方摄像头读取）进行交互，共同签署一份文档。信任并非基于传统CA，而是依托平台安全元件（如Apple Secure Enclave或Android StrongBox）生成的硬件证明令牌。该令牌通过无速率（喷泉）码完整地经视觉信道传输，并与共同签名进行密码学绑定，从而确保公钥的可信来源。协议的核心技术贡献是设计了一种两阶段哈希锚点机制，解决了交互式共同签名中固有的循环签名依赖问题：第一方在尚不知晓第二方身份时先对文档做出承诺，随后第二方的身份被绑定到该承诺，同时不使第一方的既有签名失效。作者给出了完整的威胁模型，定义了四个安全属性：锚绑定、共同签名不可分离性、基于证明的密钥来源以及签名后篡改证据，并将这些属性归约到标准密码学假设（哈希函数的抗碰撞性和底层签名方案的EUF-CMA安全性），其中安全元件被建模为理想签名预言机。论文还报告了在iOS/Android上的可工作实现，使用Secure Enclave/StrongBox中的ECDSA P-256、SHA-256、Apple App Attest/Play Integrity，以及LT风格喷泉码，并附带一个完全离线运行的第三方验证器，可重新计算所有锚点并验证两个签名。该研究为无CA、无服务器的设备间可信协作提供了新思路，适合对移动设备安全、密码协议和安全硬件感兴趣的读者。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 该协议展示了一种在无CA、无服务器依赖下建立移动设备间可信签名路径的实用方法，利用硬件安全元件和视觉信道传输证明，对零信任架构、离线或受限环境下的文档签署具有参考价值。其两阶段哈希锚点设计为解决交互式协议中的循环依赖提供了可借鉴的密码学构造思路。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 影响面包括移动端协同签名、供应链审计、离线场景的文档公证；其证明令牌传输与验证方法可迁移至IoT设备身份绑定、硬件钱包交易授权等场景。

items.title: Rethinking the Transferable Adversarial Attacks and Robust Defense in Federated Learning
items.summary: The development of federated learning (FL) techniques has helped improve the privacy preservation of users' data and extended the applications of machine learning models. However, the involvement of a large number of users in FL also creates open opportunities for different adversaries, such as poisoning attacks, Byzantine attacks, and adversarial example attacks. Yet, recent research has disclosed that existing poisoning attacks and Byzantine attacks can not achieve satisfactory penetration in realistic FL scenarios caused by strong assumptions, \textit{e.g.,} client selection rate, and the ratio of malicious attackers. In this paper, the transferability of adversarial examples among different client models is analyzed to understand the relation between adversarial examples and clients' data distribution. Moreover, to mitigate the attacks of transferable adversarial examples, we design a defense mechanism stemming from the transferability of model robustness by adversarial training. As a result, through theoretical analysis of transferability, we gain insights into adversarial examples and the vulnerability of federated learning systems. Our proposed adversarial attack and defense methods are evaluated via real-life datasets in various settings to show their performance over the existing state-of-the-art methods.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 联邦学习(FL)是一种先进的分布式机器学习范式，允许多方在不出本地数据的情况下协同训练模型，从而缓解数据隐私与孤岛问题。然而，大量参与者的加入使得FL系统面临多种安全威胁，包括数据注入攻击、模型中毒攻击、拜占庭攻击以及对抗样本攻击。近期研究指出，传统的中毒攻击和拜占庭攻击依赖于一些强假设（如客户端选择率、恶意攻击者比例等），在现实FL场景中穿透力不足，因此对抗样本攻击成为新的关注焦点。本文重新思考了FL中对抗样本攻击的可迁移性，并提出了相应的防御机制。首先，作者从理论上分析了对抗样本在不同客户端模型之间迁移的机理，揭示了客户端数据分布的异质性对可迁移性的影响，这有助于理解FL系统在对抗攻击下的脆弱性。基于对可迁移性的深刻理解，作者设计了基于对抗训练的防御方法，利用模型鲁棒性本身的可迁移性，在客户端之间传递防御能力，从而有效缓解可迁移对抗样本的威胁。实验部分在多个真实数据集上，结合不同的客户端选择率、攻击者数量等场景，全面评估了所提攻击与防御方法的性能，结果表明其优于现有最先进方法。该研究不仅为FL系统的对抗性攻击提供了理论支撑，还给出了实用的鲁棒性增强方案，对于构建安全可信的联邦学习系统具有重要价值。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 联邦学习正被广泛采用，但对抗样本攻击的威胁尚未被充分认知。该研究揭示了可迁移性这一关键属性，并给出可行的防御思路，对设计鲁棒FL系统有直接指导意义。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 影响联邦学习系统的安全性和可靠性，可迁移至分布式机器学习、隐私保护AI等场景。
defense_advice_zh: 采用对抗训练提升模型鲁棒性，尤其关注客户端数据分布差异带来的可迁移攻击风险
在联邦学习训练过程中监控模型更新中的对抗性扰动模式

items.title: Static Detection of Post-Quantum Cryptographic Algorithms in Stripped Binaries for Digital Forensic Examination and Migration Assurance
items.summary: Currently, there is no method to verify from compiled binary code whether a quantum-vulnerable algorithm has been replaced by an approved post-quantum algorithm. Cryptographic discovery tools identify algorithms by symbols, library dependencies, and runtime behaviour; however, all these signals are destroyed by stripping, statically linking, and optimising a binary. This paper presents Kestrel, a static analysis method for identifying the standardised lattice-based schemes ML-KEM and ML-DSA in stripped binary code. Kestrel identifies ML-KEM and ML-DSA by detecting the number-theoretic transform constant tables that form the read-only data upon which the arithmetic depends. The fingerprints Kestrel derives from public scheme parameters are localised by means of a normalisation-and-multiset-matching procedure; the false-positive probability is established analytically. In experiments on four independent implementation lineages and all build transformations, including compiler-level obfuscation, Kestrel achieved recall of 128 of 128 with zero false positives. Applying Kestrel to 6,224 binaries on a production Linux system disclosed twelve uncatalogued programs containing ML-KEM; these included the OpenSSH key-exchange program and the container-management stack. In several of these programs, post-quantum code entered production through the language runtime without the awareness of the projects distributing them. Kestrel distinguishes genuine post-quantum implementations from advertised claims not backed by the underlying code, attributes each detection to its originating codebase, and, in a forensic disk-image trial, recovered a detection from unallocated space after the deleted binary could no longer be reconstructed. Thus, Kestrel provides a practical basis for cryptographic migration assurance, software supply-chain inspection, and post-quantum forensic examination.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 本文提出一种名为 Kestrel 的静态分析方法，用于在剥离符号、静态链接和优化后的二进制程序中识别标准化的基于格的抗量子加密算法 ML-KEM 和 ML-DSA。当前缺乏从编译后的二进制代码验证量子脆弱算法是否已被批准的量子安全算法替换的方法；现有的密码发现工具依赖符号、库依赖和运行时行为，但这些信号在二进制剥离后都会丢失。Kestrel 的核心思路是检测 ML-KEM 和 ML-DSA 算法中数论变换（NTT）常量表，这些常量表构成只读数据，是算术运算的基础。Kestrel 从公开的算法参数中提取指纹，通过归一化和多重集匹配定位这些常量表，并从数学上分析了误报概率。实验覆盖四个独立的实现谱系和所有构建变换（包括编译器级混淆），在 128 个样本中实现了 128 个全部检出且零误报。将 Kestrel 应用于生产 Linux 系统的 6,224 个二进制文件时，发现了 12 个包含 ML-KEM 但未编目记录的程序，其中包括 OpenSSH 密钥交换程序和容器管理栈。在多个案例中，抗量子密码代码通过语言运行时进入生产环境，而分发项目并未意识到。Kestrel 能够区分真正的抗量子实现与仅宣传但底层代码不支持的声明，将每次检测归因于其原始代码库，并在磁盘镜像取证试验中，在已删除二进制无法重建时，从未分配空间恢复检测结果。因此，Kestrel 为密码学迁移保证、软件供应链检查和抗量子取证检查提供了实用基础。适合对二进制分析、密码学迁移和供应链安全感兴趣的研究人员和蓝队工程师阅读。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 帮助蓝队验证系统内是否真正部署了抗量子算法，识别通过依赖传递混入的未记录密码库，为供应链审计和取证调查提供新能力。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 可应用于企业生产系统的二进制审计、软件供应链合规检查、针对删除恶意/可疑二进制的取证恢复，以及为抗量子迁移项目提供验证手段。
detection_signals_zh: 二进制中存在 NTT 常量表特征，可能指示 ML-KEM/ML-DSA 实现
通过静态分析发现未报告的后量子密码代码片段
defense_advice_zh: 使用类似 Kestrel 的静态指纹技术对关键二进制进行例行扫描，确认抗量子算法部署状态
监控依赖中是否意外引入后量子密码库，确保供应链声明与实际代码一致
