items.title: Auto-Policy, not Auto-Skill: Compiled Agent Skills for the Physical World
items.summary: Self-evolving Skill harnesses (AutoSkills, Hermes Agent) generate more advisory orchestration automatically; their reported gains are efficiency, not safety. This misses the actual gap: a Skill describes how an agent should behave; a Policy decides which behavior is allowed to become an action. Today's format covers the first with markdown and scripts; the second is left to the model. Generating more Skills scales the gap, not the safety, especially when a wrong invocation can unlock a door or move money. Two adjacent attacks are documented: malicious skills compromising cloud software, and jailbroken LLM-controlled robots causing physical harm. Their intersection, malicious agent skills causing physical harm, follows directly but has not been reported. We name this class Borrowed Authority: Skills format gives the receiving agent no typed way to reject an inter-agent permission claim, so a malicious or misused Skill can drive actuation by attaching one. We propose Edge Skillguard, a typed authority layer that lives inside the Skill artifact rather than between tools as workflow engines do, with guards over world state and sensor evidence. On a live edge control-plane testbed, the guards reject 60/60 borrowed-authority requests across five attack variants without blocking benign requests, and the result holds at 5x scale and across hosts over a Tailscale mesh. These results suggest that high-risk Skills should co-package typed invocation policy with procedural knowledge, so that physical actions depend on machine-checkable evidence rather than peer-agent claims.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 本文针对当前自主智能体（Agent）技能（Skill）体系中的一个关键安全缺口展开研究。现有自进化技能库（如AutoSkills、Hermes Agent）虽然能自动生成更多编排建议，但其优化目标集中在效率而非安全性。作者指出，技能（Skill）描述的是智能体应如何行动，而策略（Policy）决定何种行为被允许转化为实际动作；当前格式（Markdown+脚本）仅覆盖前者，后者仍完全依赖模型自由判断。因此，持续生成更多技能只会扩大这一认知与实践之间的鸿沟，尤其在错误调用技能可能导致开门或转账等物理/现实后果的场景下，安全风险急剧上升。论文援引两类已见诸报道的攻击：恶意技能危害云软件，以及被越狱的LLM控制机器人造成物理伤害；二者的交集——恶意技能造成物理伤害——虽顺理成章但尚无公开报告。作者将此类威胁命名为“借用权威”（Borrowed Authority）：技能格式未赋予接收智能体类型化的方式来拒绝跨智能体的权限声明，恶意或被滥用的技能可通过附加权限声明驱动物理执行机构。为此，论文提出Edge Skillguard——一种内嵌于技能工件中的类型化权威层（而非像工作流引擎那样置于工具之间），对世界状态和传感器证据实施守卫。在实时边缘控制面测试台上，守卫能在五种攻击变体的60/60次借用权威请求中全部拒绝且不阻塞良性请求，并在5倍规模及Tailscale网格跨主机场景下保持有效。结果表明，高风险技能应将类型化调用策略与程序性知识共同封装，使物理动作依赖机器可验证的证据而非对等智能体的声明。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 首次系统化提出“借用权威”攻击类别，揭示当前Agent技能格式重效率轻安全的根本缺陷，并给出可落地的类型化守卫方案，对构建物理世界可信任的LLM智能体具有重要参考价值。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 影响所有将LLM技能直接对接物理设备或资金操作的Agent系统，如智能家居、机器人控制、自动化支付等；其攻击模式可迁移至MCP/Tool-use场景，为边缘控制平面的安全设计提供新考量。
detection_signals_zh: 技能调用链中存在跨智能体的权限声明异常
技能工件中附加了非预期的物理动作类型或传感器访问请求
同一技能在多次调用中权限行为不一致
defense_advice_zh: 在技能文件中显式声明类型化调用策略，禁止隐式权限继承
对物理动作实施基于世界状态和传感器证据的守卫验证
采用Edge Skillguard式设计，将策略与技能工件共存
在高风险技能上强制机器可检查的证据链，而非信任对等智能体声明

items.title: Prompt Structure Redistributes, Not Reduces: An Empirical Analysis of Security-Weaknesses in LLM-Generated Python Code
items.summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) increasingly generate code from natural-language prompts, making prompt engineering a key mechanism for shaping the security of generated software. Structured and security-oriented prompts are widely used to encourage safer code, yet their effects extend beyond whether detected weaknesses are simply present or absent. Using 424 security-sensitive Python tasks, we generate solutions with GPT-4o and LLaMA 3.1-8B under five prompt variants that progressively add structural and security guidance, and evaluate them with Bandit and CodeQL along two axes: generation compliance and security weakness prevalence, severity, and CWE distributions. Structured prompting substantially reduces refusals (e.g., GPT-4o invalid outputs drop from 338 of 424 to 37-52), enabling large-scale analysis, but security-oriented refinements do not consistently reduce overall weakness prevalence. For GPT-4o, stronger prompts primarily redistribute risk: high-severity findings fall (20.8% to 13.6%) while low-severity findings rise (32% to 43.5%); LLaMA shows weaker, less consistent shifts. We also observe security-driven semantic drift, where stricter prompts silently remove or rewrite explicitly requested unsafe constructs. Overall, prompt structure improves compliance but is an unreliable substitute for robust security controls in LLM-assisted development.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 本文研究提示词结构对大型语言模型（LLM）生成代码安全性的影响，而非单纯关注漏洞存在与否。作者使用 424 个安全敏感的 Python 编程任务，在五种逐步增加结构和安全指导的提示词变体下，分别用 GPT-4o 和 LLaMA 3.1-8B 生成代码，并利用 Bandit 和 CodeQL 从生成合规性、安全弱点普遍性、严重性和 CWE 分布两个维度进行评估。实验发现，结构化提示能显著减少模型拒绝生成的情况（例如 GPT-4o 的无效输出从 424 中的 338 降至 37-52），从而支持大规模分析，但安全导向的提示优化并不能持续降低整体弱点出现率。对于 GPT-4o，更强的提示主要使风险重新分布：高危发现从 20.8% 降至 13.6%，而低危发现从 32% 升至 43.5%；LLaMA 则表现出较弱且不一致的变化。此外，研究观察到安全驱动的语义漂移现象，即更严格的提示会悄悄移除或重写用户明确要求的非安全构造。总体而言，提示结构提高了合规性，但在 LLM 辅助开发中不能替代稳健的安全控制。该研究对依赖提示工程来提升代码安全性的实践提出了重要警示，适合软件工程、AI 安全和开发安全团队阅读。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 提示工程常被视为提升 LLM 生成代码安全性的廉价手段，但本研究证明它只是重新分配风险而非降低风险，提醒安全从业者不能过度依赖提示词，而应配合其他安全控制措施。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 影响所有使用 LLM 辅助开发并依赖提示词来确保代码安全的组织和工具链；尤其对 AI 代码生成平台的安全评估和 CWE 分布理解有参考价值。
detection_signals_zh: 在 LLM 生成的代码中同时关注高危和低危漏洞分布，避免仅统计总数
监控因提示词强化而导致代码语义发生非预期变化的情况（语义漂移）
defense_advice_zh: 不要将提示词作为唯一安全防线，应结合静态分析、人工审查和运行时防护
对生成代码按 CWE 和严重性进行分层评估，识别风险转移而非单纯减少

items.title: Research Methodologies for Cybersecurity in Enterprise Environments: A Narrative Review, Synthesis and Executable Guide
items.summary: Enterprise cybersecurity research draws on a wider range of methods than any single community routinely teaches. Researchers face a selection problem before they face a technical one: a study may simultaneously need a systematic review, a design-science artifact, a controlled detection experiment, an interview study, or an attack-graph model. This paper addresses that problem in two ways. First, it provides a narrative review and synthesis of methodological practices across a verified corpus of 151 works. We organise these practices into eleven methodology families, detailing for each what questions it answers, the strength of its supporting evidence, and its common failure modes. Second, we convert each family into an executable protocol comprising ordered steps, required instruments, evaluation criteria, common validity threats, and a reporting checklist. Every protocol is also visually mapped to make the sequence, decisions, and threats legible at a glance. We also treat contradictions in the literature as evidence. For example, reported rankings of intrusion-detection algorithms are wildly inconsistent across individually careful studies. We argue this pattern is most parsimoniously explained by variations in evaluation design rather than the algorithms themselves, as these studies differ in design dimensions known to shift results by more than the margins separating the algorithms. Ultimately, the evidence supports methodological pluralism disciplined by explicit validity reasoning. We conclude that researchers must match their evaluation design to the decision under study, triangulate technical against organisational evidence, explicitly state the population a result generalises to, and report the conditions under which the result would not hold.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 本文是一篇关于企业环境中网络安全研究方法的叙述性综述与综合，并提供了可执行的指南。作者指出，企业网络安全研究涉及的方法范围远超任何单一学术社区常规教授的内容，研究人员在面临技术问题之前首先面临方法选择问题：一项研究可能同时需要系统综述、设计科学制品、受控检测实验、访谈研究或攻击图建模等。为解决这一问题，论文以151篇经过验证的文献为语料，对这些方法论实践进行了叙述性回顾与综合，归纳出十一个方法论家族，并详细阐述了每个家族所回答的问题、支持证据的强度以及常见失败模式。在此基础上，作者将每个方法论家族转化为可执行的协议，包括有序步骤、所需工具、评估标准、常见效度威胁和报告清单，并通过可视化图谱使流程、决策与威胁一目了然。论文还探讨了文献中的矛盾现象，例如不同研究中入侵检测算法的排名结果极不一致，并认为这是由评估设计的差异（而非算法本身）造成的，因为实验设计中的一些维度足以导致远超算法间差距的结果偏移。最终，作者主张采用方法论多元主义，并以明确的效度推理加以约束；研究者必须使评估设计与待研究的决策相匹配，将技术证据与组织证据进行三角验证，明确说明结果可推广的总体范围，并报告结果不成立的条件。本文的主要贡献在于提供了一个结构化的方法论框架，帮助研究者系统化设计严谨的网络安全研究，并减少因方法论误用导致的结论不可靠问题。适合安全研究人员、学术研究者、企业内部安全评估团队以及希望深入理解网络安全实证研究方法的从业者阅读。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 该论文为安全研究提供了规范化方法论纲领，帮助从业者理解不同研究方法的适用范围与常见缺陷，避免因评估设计不当得出误导性结论，提升企业内部安全研究与评估的可信度。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 方法论框架可迁移至企业内部安全评估、安全工具选型对比、学术研究设计等场景，有助于标准化评估流程并提高研究结论的可靠性。

items.title: Certified Randomness without Structure Against Shallow-Query Adversaries
items.summary: In a recent breakthrough, Yamakawa and Zhandry (J. ACM 2024) constructed a proof of quantumness in the quantum random oracle model (QROM) in which the quantum prover samples a codeword preimage of a publicly computable function H. They conjectured that given any H, a successful prover must sample their preimage from a high-entropy distribution over possible answers. If true, this would give a certifiable randomness protocol in the quantum random oracle model. As partial evidence for their conjecture, Yamakawa and Zhandry proved the security of their certifiable randomness protocol assuming the Aaronson-Ambainis conjecture. We prove the security of the certifiable randomness protocol of Yamakawa-Zhandry unconditionally, without relying on the unproven Aaronson-Ambainis conjecture, against low query-depth quantum adversaries: specifically, adversaries that make up to o(\log λ) adaptive quantum queries to the random oracle.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 该论文研究量子计算中的可认证随机性（certifiable randomness），即如何让一个量子证明者向经典验证者证明自己确实进行了量子计算，并同时产生可验证的随机数。此前 Yamakawa 和 Zhandry（J. ACM 2024）在量子随机预言机模型（QROM）中构建了一个量子性证明（proof of quantumness），其核心思路是让量子证明者对一个公开可计算函数 H 采样一个码字原像，并猜测该函数在随机预言机下具有某种结构。他们猜想：给定任何 H，成功的证明者必须从高熵分布中采样原像，并基于 Aaronson-Ambainis 猜想证明了其可认证随机性协议的安全性。本论文的主要贡献是：在不依赖 Aaronson-Ambainis 猜想的情况下，无条件证明了 Yamakawa-Zhandry 可认证随机性协议的安全性，但对抗的是低查询深度（shallow-query）的量子 adversary——具体指最多对随机预言机进行 o(log λ) 次自适应量子查询的对手。这一结果意味着，在更弱的对手模型下，可认证随机性可以基于更少的未证明假设实现。该研究属于量子密码学与计算复杂性理论的交叉领域，对理解量子优势的验证、随机性的可信生成以及量子计算与经典验证之间的交互具有重要意义。适合对量子密码学、量子复杂性、随机性协议和可验证量子计算感兴趣的研究人员阅读。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 可认证随机性是可验证量子计算的核心应用，该结果去除了一个长期未证明的猜想依赖，在更弱的对手模型下提供了无条件安全保证，为构建实际可用的量子随机性生成协议提供了坚实的理论依据。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 影响量子随机性协议的理论基础，可能推动未来在 QROM 下设计更高效的量子性证明和随机性生成方案，尤其适用于需要信任最小化的密码协议和随机信标场景。

items.title: Masked Differential-linear Distinguishers and Quantum Approaches
items.summary: We introduce masked auto-correlation, a new primitive for the cryptanalysis of symmetric-key primitives, together with a quantum attack pipeline built on it. For a permutation $f$, output masks $α,β$, and an input difference $w$, masked auto-correlation (MAC) measures the correlation between the masked outputs $α\cdot f(x)$ and $β\cdot f(x\oplus w)$. The associated masked differential-linear (MDL) approximations strictly generalize several classical techniques; ordinary linear cryptanalysis, differential-linear cryptanalysis, and the differential-linear connectivity table all arise as special cases. Our central object of study is the problem of finding mask pairs with large masked cross-correlation -- those that yield powerful distinguishers -- which we call MAC Fishing. We give a constant-query quantum algorithm that samples such pairs according to their squared correlation, and we prove an exponential classical lower bound of $Ω(N/\log N)$ queries, by adapting the hardness of Fourier Fishing. To our knowledge this is the first result pairing a quantum upper bound with a classical lower bound for the core task of identifying high-correlation approximations, making quantum algorithms an absolute necessity. Building on this, we analyse the distribution of masked auto-correlation for random permutations, and then construct capacity-based distinguishers and key-recovery attacks, both classically and with a quadratic quantum speed-up using amplitude estimation. We validate our claims with experiments on reduced-round mini-AES.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 该论文提出一种用于对称密钥密码分析的新原语——掩码自相关（Masked Auto-correlation, MAC），并基于此构建了量子攻击流水线。对于给定的置换 f、输出掩码 α、β 以及输入差分 w，掩码自相关度量了掩码输出 α·f(x) 与 β·f(x⊕w) 之间的相关性。作者证明相应的掩码差分-线性（MDL）近似严格推广了多种经典密码分析技术，普通线性密码分析、差分-线性密码分析和差分-线性连接表均是其特例。核心研究问题是寻找具有大掩码互相关的掩码对（即能产生强区分器的掩码对），称为 MAC Fishing。他们给出了一个常数查询量子算法，能够根据平方相关度对这样的掩码对进行采样，并通过改编 Fourier Fishing 的困难性，证明了经典情形下需要 Ω(N/log N) 次查询的指数级下界。据作者所知，这是首个将量子上界与经典下界配对用于识别高相关近似的工作，表明量子算法在此核心任务上具有绝对必要性。在此基础上，论文分析了随机置换下掩码自相关的分布，然后构建了基于容量（capacity）的区分器和密钥恢复攻击，既包含经典版本，也利用振幅估计实现了二次量子加速。最后，作者在缩减轮数的 mini-AES 上进行了实验，验证了所提出方法的有效性。该研究属于理论密码分析前沿，重点在于量子计算为对称密码分析带来的新能力，尚未发现实际利用案例。适合对量子密码分析、对称密码算法安全性评估以及后量子密码迁移感兴趣的研究人员和高级安全分析师阅读。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 该工作揭示了量子算法在对称密钥密码分析中的潜在优势，为评估后量子时代经典密码算法的实际安全性提供了新的理论工具，安全团队应关注此类进展对未来加密标准迁移的影响。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 现阶段属于理论研究成果，未显示任何在野利用或武器化迹象；其影响主要体现在密码学研究和未来量子安全设计，可能为更高效的量子攻击铺路，但不会立即威胁当前部署的加密系统。
defense_advice_zh: 关注对称密码算法在量子威胁模型下的安全性评估，特别是 AES、ChaCha20 等常用原语。
跟踪后量子密码迁移进展，确保长期保密性要求较高的系统及时切换到 PQC 方案。
将量子密码分析论文作为预警信号，参与行业标准讨论以评估量子攻击的实际可行性。

items.title: Security Education in Higher Education through AI-Powered Gamification
items.summary: Cybersecurity education is facing more challenges as AI-driven attacks are becoming increasingly realistic and difficult to detect. Traditional video-based cybersecurity training in higher education often suffers from both low engagement and limited effectiveness. This dilemma motivates educators to explore innovative approaches, such as AI-powered gamification, which can deliver engaging, meaningful, and personalized learning experiences. By presenting content in a more interactive and user-friendly way, these methods have the potential to significantly improve both learner engagement and educational outcomes. This paper explores AI-powered gamification in cybersecurity education through the development of several short, mobile-friendly games. These games cover a range of topics from password security to text and phone scam recognition, incorporate multiple gamification strategies, including quiz-based, narrative-based, and simulation-based designs, as well as interactive formats such as TikTok Mini-Games. We conducted a two-tiered evaluation with 59 college students (comprising 9 technical experts and 50 general users), and the results indicate the potential of AI-powered gamification to improve engagement and increase attention to cybersecurity topics in higher education.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 随着AI驱动的攻击越来越逼真且难以检测，网络安全教育面临更大挑战。传统基于视频的安全培训在高等教育中往往存在参与度低、教学效果有限的问题，这促使教育工作者探索AI赋能的游戏化教学方式，以提供更具吸引力、有意义且个性化的学习体验。本文研究了AI游戏化在网络安全教育中的应用，开发了多款移动端友好的短小游戏，内容涵盖密码安全、文本及电话诈骗识别等主题。游戏融合了多种游戏化策略，包括测验型、叙事型和模拟型设计，并采用TikTok迷你游戏等互动形式。研究者对59名大学生（包括9名技术专家和50名普通用户）进行了两级评估，结果显示AI游戏化有潜力提升学习参与度，并增强学生对网络安全主题的关注。本研究为高等教育中的网络安全教学提供了创新思路，并通过实证数据初步验证了其有效性，对后续安全培训工具的设计具有参考价值。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 安全意识培训是安全防御体系的重要一环，AI游戏化可显著提升参与度与效果，为组织防范社交工程和人为失误提供更高效的培训途径。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 可迁移至企业安全意识培训、校园网络安全教育、公众反诈宣传等场景，尤其适合移动端和短视频平台互动。
llm_summary.recommended_action_zh: 研究跟进，考虑在内部安全意识培训中试点类似游戏化方案

items.title: Retrieved But Not Reliable: A Survey on Attacks, and Defenses in Retrieval-Augmented Generation
items.summary: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) enhances large language models by grounding outputs in external knowledge, improving factuality and reducing hallucinations. At the same time, the retrieval-augmented pipeline introduces new robustness and security risks, including corpus poisoning, backdoor attacks, privacy leakage, and fairness violations. Despite rapid progress in this area, existing surveys remain limited in their treatment of attacker objectives, threat models, and stage-specific defenses across the full RAG pipeline. This survey presents a unified and pipeline-aware overview of RAG robustness. We formalize threat models over the corpus, retriever, and generator, and organize attacks into three main objectives: accuracy, privacy, and fairness. We further review defenses from a pipeline-aware perspective, covering the retrieval, rerank, generation, and traceback stages. In addition, we summarize robustness benchmarks and explainability methods for more deeply evaluating and explaining RAG robustness.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 该论文是一篇关于检索增强生成（Retrieval-Augmented Generation, RAG）安全性与鲁棒性的综合性综述。RAG 通过引入外部知识库来增强大语言模型，能够提升事实性并减少幻觉，但同时也引入了新的鲁棒性与安全风险，例如语料库投毒、后门攻击、隐私泄露和公平性违背。现有综述在攻击者目标、威胁模型以及覆盖整个 RAG 流水线的分阶段防御方面覆盖有限。本综述提出一个统一的、流水线感知的 RAG 鲁棒性框架：首先形式化定义语料库、检索器和生成器上的威胁模型；然后根据攻击目标将攻击分为三类：准确性攻击、隐私攻击和公平性攻击。在防御方面，论文从流水线感知的角度进行梳理，涵盖检索阶段、重排序阶段、生成阶段和溯源（traceback）阶段的防御措施。此外，论文还总结了用于评估和解释 RAG 鲁棒性的基准数据集与可解释性方法。该工作为 RAG 安全研究提供了系统性的分类和未来研究方向，适合从事大模型安全、可信 AI 以及 RAG 系统开发的学者与工程师阅读。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: RAG 正被广泛应用于企业知识库与智能助手，但安全风险常被忽视。该综述首次系统化梳理了 RAG 全链路的攻击与防御，为蓝队评估自身 RAG 系统提供了威胁建模和防御参考。

items.title: StepGuard: Learning Step-Level Guardrails with Scalable Supervision and Safety-Utility Balancing
items.summary: LLM-based agents can interact with external environments through tool invocation, but this capability also introduces security risks such as file modification, information leakage, and unauthorized actions. Existing guardrails often evaluate completed trajectories, leaving pre-execution monitoring of step-level actions underexplored. We propose StepGuard, a step-level guard model that can audit completed agent trajectories and check tool actions before they are executed. To train StepGuard, we introduce StepGen, an automatic data engine that generates safe and unsafe trajectories with the same context but different actions at the risky step. To further reduce over-defense and under-defense, we propose Balance-GRPO, which dynamically balances learning between safe and unsafe actions based on their observed accuracy. Experiments show that StepGuard achieves the highest average accuracy among open-weight guard models, with performance comparable to GPT-5.4. When used to guard agents on AgentDojo and AgentDyn, StepGuard reduces mean attack success rate by 77.3% relative to the no-guard setting, while mean utility drops by only 2.8 percentage points.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 本文提出 StepGuard，一个面向 LLM 智能体的步骤级安全护栏模型。随着 LLM 智能体通过工具调用与外部环境交互，其能力也引入了文件修改、信息泄露和未授权操作等安全风险。现有的安全护栏大多在完整轨迹执行后进行审计，缺乏对步骤级动作的预执行监控，无法在危险动作发生前及时阻断。StepGuard 能够审计已完成轨迹，并在工具动作执行前对其进行检查，从而在关键步骤上实现事前防御。为训练 StepGuard，作者设计了 StepGen 自动数据引擎，该引擎可在相同上下文下生成安全与非安全轨迹，且在风险步骤处仅动作不同，从而提供细粒度监督。此外，为减少过度防御（阻止安全动作）和防御不足（放行危险动作），作者提出 Balance-GRPO 算法，该算法根据安全/非安全动作的实时准确率动态调整学习权重，实现安全性与实用性的平衡。实验结果表明，StepGuard 在开放权重护栏模型中取得最高平均准确率，性能与 GPT-5.4 相当；在 AgentDojo 和 AgentDyn 数据集上用于智能体防护时，攻击成功率相对无护栏设置平均降低 77.3%，而智能体效用仅平均下降 2.8 个百分点。该工作为 LLM 智能体安全监控提供了新的步骤级防护思路，并证明了在保持高安全性的同时可最小化对任务效用的影响。适合 AI 安全研究员、LLM 应用开发者和安全工程师阅读，以理解并部署针对智能体风险的前置防御机制。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: LLM 智能体在实际应用中面临工具调用的安全风险，现有方案多为事后审计，难以防止破坏发生。StepGuard 的步骤级预执行监控填补了这一空白，显著降低攻击成功率且对效用影响小，是智能体安全防护的重要进展。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 可应用于各类 LLM 智能体应用（如 AutoGPT、Dify、LangChain 等）的实时安全防护，也可迁移至工作流审批、权限控制等关键动作拦截场景。

items.title: ICS Cybersecurity Datasets: A Systematic Meta-Review of Coverage, Evaluation Practice, and Structural Gaps
items.summary: Intrusion detection research in Industrial Control Systems (ICS) heavily depends on public datasets, yet no prior work has systematically assessed whether the collective dataset corpus supports current evaluation claims. This paper addresses this gap through a meta-review of 18 studies between 2019 and 2026, from which 83 ICS, or ICS directly related, cybersecurity datasets are identified, harmonised, and characterised using a unified five-dimensional taxonomy. The taxonomy reveals that the corpus is structurally skewed: 85.5% of datasets concentrate on late-stage OT Disruption tactics, cross-stage IT/OT progression sequences are present in only 8.4% of cases, field-device evidence at Level 0 of the Purdue hierarchy is effectively absent, and operationally sourced data accounts for only 15.7% of the collection. A parallel audit of evaluation practices shows that zero report streaming evaluation, fewer than half apply disciplined train/test partitioning, and only two satisfy reproducibility requirements. Furthermore, a taxonomy-evaluation coupling analysis shows that dataset imbalances constrain the scope and feasibility of several evaluation practices. Based on these findings, we identify three structural imbalances: i) architectural shallowness, ii) progression compression, and iii) cross-domain substitution, and derive a coordinated research agenda which covers cross-stage corpus construction, temporally structured benchmarking, event-level label standards, and governance frameworks for operational data sharing.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 本文对工业控制系统（ICS）入侵检测研究中公共数据集的使用情况进行了系统性的元审查。研究背景是，大量入侵检测研究依赖于公共数据集，但从未有工作系统地评估这些数据集整体是否支持当前研究中的评估主张。作者审查了2019至2026年间的18项研究，从中识别出83个ICS或与ICS直接相关的网络安全数据集，并使用统一的五维分类法进行协调、表征。分类法揭示数据集体质存在结构性偏差：85.5%的数据集集中于后期OT破坏战术，跨阶段IT/OT进展序列仅占8.4%，Purdue层级中Level 0现场设备级证据几乎缺失，运营来源数据仅占15.7%。同时，对评估实践的审计显示：没有报告流式评估，不到一半的研究采用严格的训练/测试划分，只有两项满足可复现性要求。此外，分类学与评估实践之间的耦合分析表明，数据集的不平衡限制了多种评估实践的范围和可行性。基于这些发现，作者识别出三个结构性失衡：架构浅层性、进展压缩和跨域替代，并提出了协调的研究议程，包括跨阶段语料库构建、时间结构化的基准测试、事件级标注标准，以及运营数据共享的治理框架。该论文的主要贡献是首次基于证据揭示了ICS数据集的整体缺陷及其对评估实践的制约，为未来研究和数据建设提供了方向。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 该论文首次系统揭示了ICS入侵检测数据集的结构性缺陷，直接影响评估结论的可靠性。安全从业者依赖这些数据训练和测试模型，而数据集的偏差可能导致模型在真实场景失效。了解这些限制有助于避免过度自信，并推动更严谨的数据选择与评估设计。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 影响ICS入侵检测研究的数据选择、模型评估和部署决策，也指导数据集构建者和资助机构优先投入跨层数据采集。
defense_advice_zh: 在使用任意ICS数据集进行模型评估前，先审查其战术阶段覆盖率和Purdue层级深度。
避免仅依赖单一数据集，应结合多源数据或使用真实运营数据验证。
关注事件级标签标准和时间序列划分，确保评估可复现。

items.title: Who Falls for SMiSh? Learning Through Survey Data Where to Best Target Awareness Training for Mobile Messaging Attacks
items.summary: As mobile phone adoption has surged, so have scams involving these devices. One such scam, known as SMiShing (or smishing) after Short Message Service (SMS), involves fraudsters sending phishing links via mobile texts. Despite the prevalence of SMiShing, there is a lack of data on who is most vulnerable to these attacks. Prior research on phishing (its email counterpart) suggests that susceptibility may vary by demographic and contextual factors. In two large-scale surveys, we use a previously published simulation method to collect data from representative samples of U.S. adult mobile phone users. Our findings indicate that younger individuals and college students are particularly vulnerable. Participants struggled to correctly identify legitimate messages, with the second study providing comparisons of financial message variants. Researchers, regulators, and telecoms can help users by creating mobile-specific interventions for under-24 and university customers and adding verifications and warnings.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 随着移动电话的普及，针对移动设备的诈骗也日益增多。SMiShing（又称smishing）是一种通过短信发送钓鱼链接的诈骗方式，攻击者利用短信服务（SMS）诱导用户点击恶意链接，进而窃取敏感信息或安装恶意软件。尽管SMiShing已十分普遍，但关于哪些人群最容易受到此类攻击的数据仍然缺乏。以往针对电子邮件钓鱼的研究表明，受害风险可能与人口统计学特征和情境因素相关。为了填补这一空白，本研究采用先前发表的模拟方法，通过两项大规模调查，收集了具有代表性的美国成年移动电话用户样本数据。调查要求参与者识别短信是否为合法消息或钓鱼消息，并评估其判断准确性。研究结果显示，年轻人和大学生尤其容易受到SMiShing攻击。参与者普遍难以正确识别合法消息，第二项研究进一步比较了金融类短信变体，发现不同情境下的识别难度存在差异。研究人员、监管机构和电信运营商可以通过为24岁以下用户和大学客户制定针对移动设备的干预措施，并增强短信验证和警告机制，来帮助用户防范此类攻击。该研究为移动端钓鱼的易感性提供了实证数据，并为设计更有效的安全教育与防线提供了方向。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 该研究为移动短信钓鱼的受害者画像提供了大规模实证数据，帮助安全团队了解哪些用户群体风险最高，从而优化安全意识培训和移动端防护策略。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 影响移动安全教育和意识培训的定制化，适用于银行、电信运营商、高校及企业移动办公场景，有助于设计针对年轻群体的防护措施。
detection_signals_zh: 关注24岁以下及大学生群体对短信链接的点击行为
识别金融类短信中用户识别率低的模式
defense_advice_zh: 为年轻用户设计移动端定向安全教育
在短信环境中增加验证提示和风险警告

items.title: Asynchronous Verifiable Information Dispersal with Low Space and Communication Complexity
items.summary: The primary goal of a distributed storage system is to ensure that clients can both write and read data in a reliable and consistent manner, even in the presence of failures. While existing asynchronous verifiable information dispersal (AVID) protocols achieve optimal space complexity for storage and communication complexity for data retrieval in a Byzantine setting, the crucial operations of data dispersal and node recovery have received less attention. We propose an efficient AVID protocol that simultaneously guarantees low complexities for dispersal, storage, retrieval, and recovery. At the core of the proposed protocol lies a novel mechanism to encode data in a two-dimensional matrix and a bespoke dispersal algorithm. The protocol maintains an optimal communication complexity for retrieval while substantially improving upon the state of the art for recovery. Additionally, we describe how the protocol can be modified in order to reduce the space complexity and the communication complexity for dispersal, at the expense of a higher communication complexity for retrieval and recovery. As the proposed protocols strike a balance across all considered metrics, they are suitable for a broad range of real-world use cases.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 本文研究分布式存储系统中的异步可验证信息分散（AVID）协议。分布式存储系统的核心目标是在存在故障（包括拜占庭故障）的情况下，确保客户端能够可靠且一致地写入和读取数据。现有的AVID协议在拜占庭设置下已经实现了存储空间复杂度和数据检索通信复杂度的最优，但数据分散和节点恢复这两个关键操作的开销却较少被关注。本文提出了一种高效的AVID协议，能够同时降低分散、存储、检索和恢复四个方面的复杂度。该协议的核心是一种新颖的二维矩阵数据编码机制，以及配套的定制化分散算法。该协议在保持检索通信复杂度最优的同时，显著改善了恢复方面的现有最优水平。此外，论文还描述了如何对协议进行修改，以进一步降低空间复杂度和分散通信复杂度，但代价是检索和恢复的通信复杂度会有所增加。由于所提出的协议在所有相关指标之间取得了平衡，因此适用于广泛的现实世界用例。本文的贡献在于提出了一种新的AVID协议设计，并给出了复杂度分析，为分布式存储系统的容错设计提供了新的思路。适合对分布式系统、拜占庭容错、信息分散、存储协议等方向感兴趣的研究人员和工程师阅读。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 该研究提升了AVID协议的实用性，使分布式存储系统能在容忍拜占庭故障的同时，降低数据分散和节点恢复的开销，对构建高效、可靠的去中心化存储有直接价值。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 可应用于区块链底层的存储层、去中心化存储网络、以及对容错性和性能都有要求的企业级分布式存储系统。

items.why_it_matters: 该研究提升了AVID协议的实用性，使分布式存储系统能在容忍拜占庭故障的同时，降低数据分散和节点恢复的开销，对构建高效、可靠的去中心化存储有直接价值。

items.title: SeriCrypt: An LLM-Driven Context-Aware Serialization Framework for Cryptographic Protocols
items.summary: Constructing syntactically correct and cryptographically valid message sequences is essential for protocol state machine learning, conformance testing, and fuzzing. Unlike plaintext protocols, cryptographic protocols involve complex cross-message state dependencies and cryptographic computation constraints. Existing automated approaches predominantly target text-based or plaintext protocols, leaving cryptographic message construction largely manual. We present SeriCrypt, an LLM-driven, context-aware serialization framework for cryptographic protocols. It employs a large language model to extract field constraints, state dependencies, and cryptographic computation rules from unstructured protocol specifications into a unified structured intermediate representation, formally characterized by a domain-specific language for cryptographic protocols (CDSL). A protocol-agnostic execution engine parses CDSL declarations, automating field value resolution, cryptographic primitive invocation, and byte-stream serialization. As case studies in protocol security testing, we use the framework to construct violation messages targeting specification-defined security constraints and to support protocol fuzzing, evaluating it on mainstream implementations of TLS 1.2/1.3, IKEv1/v2, SSH, and TLCP. SeriCrypt generated message sequences accepted by all evaluated implementations and completed handshakes in every scenario. Security constraint testing revealed five specification violations, and fuzzing reached deeper protocol states with higher code coverage than mainstream fuzzers under the same time budget, demonstrating the framework's practical value for cryptographic protocol security testing.

llm_summary.summary_zh: SeriCrypt 提出了一种面向密码学协议的、由大语言模型驱动的上下文感知序列化框架，用于解决协议状态机学习、一致性测试和模糊测试中构造语法正确且密码学上有效的消息序列这一关键问题。与明文协议不同，密码学协议具有跨消息的复杂状态依赖和密码学计算约束，而现有自动化方法主要面向基于文本的明文协议，导致密码学消息构造仍高度依赖人工。SeriCrypt 的核心创新在于利用大语言模型从非结构化的协议规范中提取字段约束、状态依赖和密码学计算规则，并将其转换为一种统一的结构化中间表示，该表示由针对密码学协议设计的领域特定语言（CDSL）形式化描述。随后，一个与具体协议无关的执行引擎解析 CDSL 声明，自动完成字段值解析、密码学原语调用和字节流序列化。作为协议安全测试的案例研究，作者使用该框架构造针对规范定义安全约束的违规消息，并支持协议模糊测试，在 TLS 1.2/1.3、IKEv1/v2、SSH 和 TLCP 的主流实现上进行了评估。结果表明，SeriCrypt 生成的消息序列被所有被测实现接受，并在所有场景中均完成了握手；安全约束测试发现了五个规范违规；在相同时间预算下，模糊测试比主流模糊器达到更深的协议状态和更高的代码覆盖率，展示了该框架在密码学协议安全测试中的实用价值。本文适合协议安全研究人员、模糊测试工具开发者和从事协议一致性测试的工程师阅读。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 密码学协议测试长期依赖手工构造消息，效率和覆盖度受限。SeriCrypt 将 LLM 与 DSL 结合，首次实现从非结构化规范到可执行序列化代码的自动化，能显著降低协议安全测试门槛，并发现真实规范违规，具备工程落地潜力。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 适用于 TLS、IPSec、SSH 等密码学协议的安全测试、状态机学习与模糊测试；其 CDSL 和 LLM 驱动的中间表示思路可迁移至其他有状态协议测试工具链。
detection_signals_zh: 生成的测试消息可能触发协议栈中非标准状态转换或异常告警
对 TLS/SSH 等协议进行深层状态探测时，可能存在异常握手行为
defense_advice_zh: 对被测协议实现进行严格的状态机一致性校验，防止不规范消息导致越界状态
在部署环境中监控异常的握手序列和密码学计算失败，及时发现针对协议实现的恶意探测

items.why_it_matters: 密码学协议测试长期依赖手工构造消息，效率和覆盖度受限。SeriCrypt 将 LLM 与 DSL 结合，首次实现从非结构化规范到可执行序列化代码的自动化，能显著降低协议安全测试门槛，并发现真实规范违规，具备工程落地潜力。

items.title: Do System Prompts Leave Behavioral Fingerprints? A Large-Scale Empirical Study of Clone Detection via Output Similarity
items.summary: System prompts can be extracted from commercial LLMs with over 80\% success and redeployed at zero cost, yet a prompt owner has no way to verify whether a suspected deployment is a clone. We propose Black-Box Behavioral Fingerprinting (BBF): the prompt owner registers a behavioral signature from model outputs and later tests whether a suspect deployment matches that signature more closely than an unrelated baseline. BBF requires only black-box API access. Through a large-scale study (4 model families, 8 benchmarks, 288{,}000 responses), we find that prompt choice explains 24.4\% of output variance and same-model detection reaches AUC 0.876. Cross-model performance is bounded by detector identity, with off-diagonal AUC ranging from 0.845 (Claude as detector) down to 0.665 (Qwen) and overall mean 0.725. BBF resists non-adaptive prompt paraphrasing (AUC $\geq 0.889$) and is robust to imperfect extraction, but a single-sentence formal-tone prefix can collapse detection on short structured outputs (MNLI 0.978 $\to$ 0.547), isolating style-invariant detection as the key open problem. Diagnostic Query Optimization, a zero-cost query selection rule, adds $+0.120$ to cross-model AUC.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 本文研究了一个现实且严峻的安全问题：商业LLM的系统提示（system prompt）可以被攻击者以超过80%的成功率提取，并以零成本重新部署，但提示所有者无法验证某个可疑部署是否为克隆。为此，作者提出了黑盒行为指纹识别（Black-Box Behavioral Fingerprinting, BBF）方法。BBF的核心思路是：提示所有者先从自身模型的输出中注册一个行为签名，随后通过黑盒API访问测试可疑部署，判断其输出是否与该签名匹配度显著高于无关基线。该方法仅需要黑盒访问，不依赖模型内部参数。作者进行了大规模实证研究，覆盖4个模型家族、8个基准测试、共288,000条响应。实验发现：提示选择解释了24.4%的输出方差；在同模型检测（即提示所有者与被测模型相同）场景下，AUC达到0.876。跨模型检测性能受检测器身份影响，非对角线AUC从Claude作为检测器时的0.845到Qwen的0.665不等，总体均值为0.725。BBF对非适应性提示改写具有鲁棒性（AUC不低于0.889），并且对不完美的提示提取也有抵抗力。然而，一个单句的正式语气前缀就可使基于短结构化输出的检测能力崩溃（MNLI任务AUC从0.978降至0.547），这凸显出风格不变性检测是未来需要解决的关键开放问题。此外，作者提出了一种零成本的查询选择规则——诊断查询优化（Diagnostic Query Optimization），可将跨模型AUC提升+0.120。该研究为系统提示的归属认证与克隆检测提供了新的技术路线，对LLM知识产权保护和供应链安全具有重要意义。适合关注LLM安全、模型指纹识别、知识产权保护的研究者和安全工程师阅读。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 系统提示是商业LLM的核心资产，提取与克隆攻击严重威胁模型知识产权。该研究首次系统性地提出并验证黑盒行为指纹识别方法，为提示所有者提供可行的克隆检测手段，是LLM安全防御的重要补充。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 可应用于商业LLM服务提供商的提示版权保护、模型部署的合规审计，以及API接入方的安全风控场景；也可迁移到其他生成式模型的指纹识别任务。
detection_signals_zh: 可疑部署的输出行为与原始提示所有者的输出分布显著相似（如AUC超过阈值）
在精心设计的诊断查询上，可疑模型与原始模型的输出一致性异常偏高
defense_advice_zh: 对系统提示进行混淆或分段管理，增加提取难度
在公开API中引入输出扰动或水印，干扰行为指纹的匹配
定期使用BBF黑盒检测可疑部署，并及时维权

items.why_it_matters: 系统提示是商业LLM的核心资产，提取与克隆攻击严重威胁模型知识产权。该研究首次系统性地提出并验证黑盒行为指纹识别方法，为提示所有者提供可行的克隆检测手段，是LLM安全防御的重要补充。

items.title: Defending Network Intrusion Detection Systems Based on Graph Neural Networks Against Structural Adversarial Attacks
items.summary: Graph Neural Networks (GNNs) represent a promising solution for Machine Learning (ML) based Network Intrusion Detection Systems (NIDS), thanks to their ability to leverage both network flow features and topological patterns. While GNN classifiers demonstrate superior robustness against feature-based adversarial attacks compared to other ML detectors, they remain vulnerable to structural adversarial attacks, where an attacker perturbs the underlying network graph topology by injecting edges or inserting nodes. Such attacks pose a realistic and severe threat, undermining the reliability of GNN-based NIDS in practical deployments. While countermeasures have been proposed in the literature, they often rely on assumptions that are unrealistic in real-world cybersecurity scenarios. In this paper, we propose a defense framework based on adversarial training to strengthen GNN-based NIDS against structural attacks. We generate adversarial samples by strategically replacing the source and destination nodes in benign network flows, thereby efficiently mimicking edge injection attacks. We evaluate our approach on two widely used datasets (CTU-13 and TON-IoT) using E-GraphSAGE as the base GNN classifier. Experimental results show that our approach produces hardened detectors with superior detection performance on clean graphs and enhanced robustness against structural adversarial attacks.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 本文针对基于图神经网络（GNN）的网络入侵检测系统（NIDS）在面对结构化对抗攻击时的脆弱性问题，提出了一种基于对抗训练的防御框架。GNN能够同时利用网络流特征和拓扑模式，在基于特征的对抗攻击下比传统ML检测器更鲁棒，但对通过注入边或插入节点来扰动图结构的攻击仍显不足。现有防御措施常依赖不切实际的假设，难以在真实网络安全场景中落地。作者通过策略性地替换良性网络流中的源节点和目的节点来生成对抗样本，高效模拟边注入攻击，并以此进行对抗训练。实验在CTU-13和TON-IoT两个公开数据集上，以E-GraphSAGE作为基础GNN分类器进行评估。结果表明，该方法能够显著提升检测器在干净图上的检测性能，同时增强对结构化对抗攻击的鲁棒性。该研究为加固GNN-based NIDS提供了实用且有效的防御思路，适合网络安全、入侵检测和对抗机器学习领域的研究者及工程人员阅读。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: GNN-based NIDS在实际部署中面临结构化攻击威胁，现有防御假设不合理。该研究提出可行的对抗训练方案，为加固此类系统提供了实证依据，对蓝队设计鲁棒检测器具有参考价值。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 适用于基于图神经网络的网络入侵检测系统，尤其在使用CTU-13、TON-IoT等流数据场景，可迁移至其他需防御图结构扰动的检测任务。
detection_signals_zh: 网络流中异常边注入或节点插入行为
图拓扑结构突变导致GNN输出置信度异常
defense_advice_zh: 采用对抗训练生成模拟边注入样本以增强模型鲁棒性
在模型部署时监控图结构变化并设置异常检测阈值

items.why_it_matters: GNN-based NIDS在实际部署中面临结构化攻击威胁，现有防御假设不合理。该研究提出可行的对抗训练方案，为加固此类系统提供了实证依据，对蓝队设计鲁棒检测器具有参考价值。

items.title: A Drop-in KEM Replacement for Client Signatures in Post-Quantum SSH
items.summary: The transition to post-quantum cryptography is reshaping the Secure Shell (SSH) protocol for remote administration. Post-quantum key exchange has been deployed in OpenSSH and is being standardized, while SSH authentication largely remains a signature-replacement effort. This path preserves the familiar public-key credential model, but inherits the size and computation overhead of post-quantum signatures, which can increase latency, traffic, and server-side load. KEM-based authentication offers a natural alternative to this signature-centric path, and SSH makes this especially attractive at the user-authentication layer, which is method-extensible, separated from transport-layer key exchange and host-key authentication, and already protected by the established channel. We present a drop-in KEM-based user-authentication method for SSH that replaces client public-key signatures with a session-bound challenge-response proof. The method fits into SSH's existing user-authentication framework, preserving the public-key credential model and enabling incremental deployment alongside existing methods. We provide a reduction-based security argument in the post-quantum ACCE framework, implement the design in OpenSSH using liboqs, and evaluate it under representative RTTs, TCP initial-window settings, and post-quantum migration configurations. Our results show that KEM-based authentication is competitive with compact signature-based authentication under representative network settings, while reducing median handshake latency by up to about 10% against large-signature hybrid baselines. The advantages are clearer when post-quantum signatures stress transmission or computation: median latency under small TCP initial windows falls by up to 7.3% versus ML-DSA and 17.9% versus SLH-DSA, while server-side online cryptographic cost is 59.1% lower than that for ML-DSA in the same NIST category.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 本文研究后量子密码迁移背景下 SSH 协议的用户认证方案。当前 SSH 向抗量子密码过渡主要聚焦于密钥交换（已在 OpenSSH 部署并标准化），而认证层仍依赖后量子签名替换，导致公钥凭据模型保留但引入了较大的签名尺寸与计算开销，可能增加时延、流量与服务端负载。作者提出一种基于 KEM 的用户认证方法，作为客户端公钥签名的即插即用替代方案：利用会话绑定的挑战-响应证明，将客户端认证从签名改为 KEM 解密/封装验证。该设计紧密适配 SSH 现有用户认证框架，保留公钥凭据模型，可与现有认证方法共存并支持分阶段增量部署。安全性方面，论文在后量子 ACCE（认证与保密信道建立）框架下给出了基于规约的安全论证。实现上，作者基于 OpenSSH 和 liboqs 完成了原型，并在代表性的 RTT、TCP 初始窗口大小和后量子迁移配置下进行了性能评测。实验结果显示：在典型网络环境下，KEM 认证与紧凑签名认证性能相当；相比大签名混合基线，中位握手时延最多降低约 10%。当后量子签名在传输或计算上成为瓶颈时优势更显著：在小 TCP 初始窗口下，中位时延相比 ML-DSA 降低 7.3%，相比 SLH-DSA 降低 17.9%；在同一 NIST 安全级别下，服务端在线密码学成本比 ML-DSA 低 59.1%。该研究为 SSH 后量子认证提供了一条非签名中心的可行路径，尤其适合对握手时延和服务端开销敏感的远程管理场景。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 为 SSH 后量子认证提供绕过大体积签名的 KEM 替代方案，显著降低握手时延和服务端计算开销，有助于蓝队规划后量子迁移并优化现有基础设施性能。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 影响 SSH 协议实现（如 OpenSSH）、后量子认证标准化方向以及依赖 SSH 的自动化运维和批量管理场景。

items.why_it_matters: 为 SSH 后量子认证提供绕过大体积签名的 KEM 替代方案，显著降低握手时延和服务端计算开销，有助于蓝队规划后量子迁移并优化现有基础设施性能。

items.title: Not All Tokens Are Equal: Region-Aware Consistency Repair of Backdoors in MLLMs
items.summary: MLLMs are increasingly deployed in user-facing applications, yet they inherit backdoor risks from the pipelines used to construct them: triggers may reside in images, texts, or both. Existing model-level backdoor removal methods, largely designed for conventional classifiers, show limited effectiveness on MLLMs, while MLLM-specific defenses mainly operate at inference time, filtering suspicious inputs without removing the backdoor embedded in the model. To address this gap and eliminate latent backdoors from MLLMs at their source, we present RACER, a model-level repair framework motivated by a key observation: backdoors induce abnormal layer-to-layer evolution in internal representations, which we term the layer-wise inconsistency anomaly. Importantly, this anomaly is modality-dependent, concentrating primarily in the token region encoding the trigger features that the backdoor model actually relies on. RACER therefore decomposes the fused representation into visual and textual token regions, normalizes their layer-wise inconsistency separately, and recomposes them using modality-aware weights over a deep-layer window, yielding a region-aware inconsistency objective that better captures localized backdoor-induced anomalies. Through a min-max optimization, this objective drives worst-case perturbation synthesis and adversarial fine-tuning against the resulting perturbation to repair the model, suppressing the deep representational directional shifts on which backdoor behaviors rely. RACER requires only 100 clean samples and no knowledge of the trigger, attack objective, or even whether the input model contains a backdoor. Evaluations on three open-source MLLMs across 36 backdoor settings spanning image, text, and multimodal triggers show that RACER reduces the average ASR to 1.1%, reaching 0% in 32 settings, while preserving clean-task utility on both backdoor and clean models.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）正越来越多地部署在面向用户的应用中，但其构建流程可能引入后门风险，触发器可存在于图像、文本或两者兼有。现有的模型级后门移除方法大多针对传统分类器，在MLLM上效果有限；而专门的MLLM防御多在推理阶段进行，通过过滤可疑输入，无法真正消除嵌入模型的后门。本文提出RACER（区域感知一致性修复框架），从源头消除MLLM中的潜在后门。关键发现是：后门会导致内部表示在逐层传播过程中出现异常演化，作者称之为“逐层不一致性异常”，且该异常具有模态依赖性，主要集中在编码实际依赖的触发特征的token区域。RACER将融合表示分解为视觉和文本token区域，分别对各区域的逐层不一致性进行归一化，然后利用模态感知权重在深层窗口上重新组合，形成区域感知的不一致性目标。通过极小极大优化，该目标驱动最坏情况扰动合成，并针对该扰动进行对抗性微调以修复模型，抑制后门行为所依赖的深层表示方向性偏移。RACER仅需100个干净样本，无需知道触发器、攻击目标，甚至无需知道模型是否包含后门。在3个开源MLLM、36个涵盖图像、文本和多模态触发器的后门设置上的评估表明，RACER将平均攻击成功率（ASR）降至1.1%，其中32个设置达到0%，同时保持了干净任务效用（在带后门和干净模型上）。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: MLLM后门是实际部署中的严重威胁，现有防御多为推理时过滤，无法根除内嵌后门。RACER作为模型级修复方法，无需触发器知识，仅需少量干净样本即可显著降低攻击成功率，为MLLM的安全性提供了可落地的净化方案，对AI安全运营与合规具有重要参考价值。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 适用于视觉-语言模型（如开源MLLM）的后门清理，可集成到模型发布前的安全审计流程中，也可迁移到其他多模态架构的防御。
detection_signals_zh: 模型内部表示在深层窗口上出现逐层不一致性异常，且异常集中于特定模态token区域
defense_advice_zh: 在部署MLLM前，使用RACER等模型级防御进行后门净化
结合推理时输入过滤与模型内后门消除，形成分层防御体系

items.title: Towards LLM-Enhanced Android Taint Analysis
items.summary: Taint analysis is a fundamental technique for detecting sensitive data leaks in Android apps. However, traditional static tools, such as FlowDroid, still face well-known challenges due to the complexity of accurately modeling the Android framework. In this paper, we investigate whether off-the-shelf Large Language Models (LLMs) can effectively reason about taint flows in Android apps. Our preliminary approach relies on an agentic interaction strategy, enabling the LLM to iteratively explore code and reason about data flows. We conduct an initial evaluation on the DroidBench benchmark against FlowDroid, where our approach outperforms the baseline: Gemini-3 Flash achieves an F1-score of 0.96, compared to 0.55 for FlowDroid. In particular, we observe improvements in challenging categories such as inter-component communication (0.95 vs. 0.17), implicit flows (0.94 vs. 0.00), and reflection (1.00 vs. 0.50), where FlowDroid typically struggles. On a small set of real-world apps, the LLM-based approach also identifies additional potential data leaks not reported by FlowDroid. These preliminary findings suggest that LLM reasoning may effectively complement traditional static taint analysis, motivating future research on hybrid LLM-enhanced taint analysis pipelines.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 本文旨在探索现成的大型语言模型（LLM）能否有效推理安卓应用中的污点流，以解决传统静态分析工具在准确建模 Android 框架方面长期存在的挑战。作者提出了一种基于代理交互（agentic interaction）的初步方法：LLM 通过迭代的方式检查代码片段、推理数据从源（source）到汇聚点（sink）的传播路径，并做出是否存在敏感数据泄露的判断。在 DroidBench 基准上，作者使用 Gemini-3 Flash 进行了初步评估，并与业界标准工具 FlowDroid 比较。结果显示，该方法的 F1 分数达到 0.96，远高于 FlowDroid 的 0.55。尤其在具有挑战性的类别中表现突出：组件间通信（ICC）的 F1 为 0.95 vs FlowDroid 的 0.17，隐式流为 0.94 vs 0.00，反射为 1.00 vs 0.50。此外，在少量真实世界的安卓应用上，LLM 方法报告了 FlowDroid 未发现的额外潜在数据泄漏。这些初步证据表明，LLM 的语义理解能力能够补充传统静态污点分析的不足，并启发未来构建混合式 LLM 增强污点分析管道的研究方向。该工作对恶意应用分析、隐私合规检测等场景具有潜在价值。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 该研究展示了 LLM 在安卓隐私泄漏检测上的巨大潜力，尤其是传统工具无能为力的隐式流和反射场景。它预示着未来的恶意应用分析与隐私审计可能采用 LLM 辅助的混合方案，值得安全团队关注评估。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 影响面集中于安卓静态分析工具链、移动应用安全审计和隐私合规检测。该方法可迁移到其他平台或语言的污点分析，以及组件间通信相关的漏洞检测场景。

items.why_it_matters: 该研究展示了 LLM 在安卓隐私泄漏检测上的巨大潜力，尤其是传统工具无能为力的隐式流和反射场景。它预示着未来的恶意应用分析与隐私审计可能采用 LLM 辅助的混合方案，值得安全团队关注评估。

items.title: Evaluating and Preventing Security Smells in AI-Generated Ansible Code
items.summary: AI coding assistants generate Infrastructure as Code, yet no work has examined whether this code meets security requirements. This matters because security smells in infrastructure code propagate to deployed systems, producing infrastructure that is insecure and untrustworthy. We evaluate 16 AI models generating Ansible roles for Apache Tomcat v10 and MongoDB v7, analysing 278 Ansible roles against CIS benchmarks. Without security guidance, all 16 AI models produced code containing security smells, resulting in vulnerable infrastructure that fails compliance verification and underperforms code written by human developers. We introduce an approach integrating Ansible best practices and CIS benchmarks into prompts through an extended CO-STAR framework, enabling security smell prevention during synthesis rather than detection after deployment. When this approach is applied, 4 out of 16 models generate compliant code, with the leading model achieving 95%-100% CIS compliance, a fourfold improvement over humans at 23%-43%, with overall code quality improving by 19%-49%. The remaining 12 models fail not because they cannot generate code but because they cannot follow instructions with multiple constraints. For capable models, the approach requires no retraining and can be adopted through system prompts.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 本文研究了AI编程助手生成的基础设施即代码（IaC）中存在的安全问题。以往研究大多关注AI生成代码的功能正确性，但对其安全性关注不足。作者指出，如果基础设施代码存在安全缺陷，会直接传播到部署的系统，导致不可信的基础设施。论文评估了16个AI模型生成Ansible角色（用于Apache Tomcat v10和MongoDB v7）的情况，共分析278个角色，并与CIS基准进行了比对。结果发现，在没有安全指导的情况下，所有16个模型生成的代码都存在安全味道（security smells），导致基础设施易受攻击、无法通过合规验证，且整体性能不如人类开发者编写的代码。为此，作者提出了一种新方法：通过扩展CO-STAR框架，将Ansible最佳实践和CIS基准整合到提示词中，使AI在代码生成阶段就能预防安全味道，而非在部署后再检测。应用该方法后，16个模型中有4个能够生成合规代码，其中表现最好的模型达到了95%-100%的CIS合规率，相比人类开发者的23%-43%提升了四倍，同时整体代码质量提升了19%-49%。其余12个模型失败的原因并非无法生成代码，而是无法遵循包含多重约束的指令。对于能力足够的模型，该方法无需重新训练，只需通过系统提示词即可采用。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: AI生成IaC日益常见，但安全合规性常被忽视。该研究量化了风险并提出提示词层面的预防方案，对依赖AI辅助编码的蓝队/SOC团队有直接参考价值，可避免将不安全基础设施引入生产环境。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 影响所有使用AI助手生成Ansible等IaC的团队，特别是涉及Tomcat/MongoDB等常见组件时。方法可迁移至其他IaC工具（如Terraform、CloudFormation）及其他安全基准。
detection_signals_zh: AI生成的Ansible代码中出现重复使用sudo等危险权限或缺乏文件权限配置
生成的配置中未定义失败策略或未限制错误处理方式
使用硬编码密钥或未经加密的变量信息
配置边界未按照CIS基准进行设置（如Tomcat的server.xml或MongoDB的配置文件）
defense_advice_zh: 在AI编码助手的系统提示词中集成CIS基准和Ansible最佳实践
对AI生成的IaC进行自动化静态扫描，并与CIS基准对齐
建立人工审查机制，特别是对安全相关配置进行双重验证
优先选择在提示词引导下能遵循多重约束的模型

items.title: Anatomy of a Scam Call: What 10,000 real scam and spam calls reveal about how phone scammers operate
items.summary: Telephone fraud is pervasive and costly, but its inner workings are rarely observed at scale. We analyze a complete corpus of 10,211 inbound scam and spam calls -- 913 hours of audio and 330,956 transcribed turns from 5,780 distinct numbers -- collected over 54 days by an AI voice-agent honeypot that answered callers and kept them talking, and introduced in a companion data descriptor. We separate outright scams, which solicit sensitive information, from the larger stream of predatory but legal lead generation ("spam") that feeds them. Scam operations keep office hours (6.6x more calls per weekday than weekend day); thousands of disposable numbers run a small catalog of recycled scripts (thirty opening clusters, half the traffic in the top five); and callers solicit identity anchors -- a home address and a date of birth -- far more often than payment credentials, pressing through persistence and manufactured authority rather than overt threats. Our central experiment asks: does it matter who picks up? Every seeded lead carried one of ten fictitious identities drawn uniformly at random, so the identity a fraud operation reaches is fixed before the caller exists. Across 1,823 randomized calls, scammers spent about 15% more conversational turns per decade of the target's apparent age (rate ratio 1.15, 95% CI 1.08-1.23; randomization p = 0.005) -- yet what they asked for did not change (26.3% of calls reached a request for sensitive information; odds ratio 0.99 per decade, 95% CI 0.90-1.08). A second experiment casts early detection as a benchmark: from a scammer's opening lines alone, on a caller-disjoint split, escalation is predictable at 0.72 ROC-AUC from the first line and 0.87 by the eighth, and a plain bag-of-words classifier matches a fine-tuned on-device language model. Telephone fraud emerges as a templated industry that varies how hard it works a target, but not what it wants.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 该论文基于一个由AI语音代理蜜罐系统收集的独特数据集，对电话诈骗和垃圾电话的运作模式进行了大规模实证分析。数据集包含54天内来自5,780个不同号码的10,211通入站电话，共计913小时音频和330,956轮对话转录。研究首先区分了真正骗取敏感信息的诈骗电话与虽然具有掠夺性但合法的线索生成（垃圾）电话，发现诈骗运营遵循工作时间规律（工作日的电话量是周末的6.6倍），大量一次性号码使用少量循环脚本（30个开场聚类，前五个占据一半流量）。诈骗者更常索要身份锚点（家庭住址和出生日期），而非支付凭证，通过坚持和制造权威而非直接威胁来施压。核心实验围绕“接听者身份是否重要”展开：每条线索随机分配十个虚构身份之一，在1,823通随机电话中，目标表观年龄每增加十年，诈骗者多花费约15%的对话轮次（比率1.15，95% CI 1.08-1.23，p=0.005），但索要的内容没有显著变化（26.3%的电话达到索要敏感信息阶段，每十年优势比0.99）。第二个实验将早期检测作为基准任务：仅凭诈骗者的开场白，在呼叫者不相交的划分上，从第一行预测升级的ROC-AUC为0.72，到第八行达到0.87，且简单的词袋分类器与微调的端侧语言模型表现相当。研究结论认为电话诈骗是一个模板化行业，其工作强度因目标而异，但索要的内容不变。该研究适用于理解电话诈骗的社会工程策略、开发自动检测系统以及相关反欺诈政策制定，主要面向语言处理、网络安全和计算社会科学领域的研究者。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 该研究首次以大规模真实通话数据揭示电话诈骗的模板化运作模式，证明诈骗者行为可预测，为构建语音层面的诈骗早期检测系统提供了数据支撑和基线方法。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 影响电话诈骗检测系统的设计，可迁移到语音助手、实时通话监控、反欺诈风控等场景；其公开数据集可复用于社会工程学分析和AI安全研究。

items.why_it_matters: 该研究首次以大规模真实通话数据揭示电话诈骗的模板化运作模式，证明诈骗者行为可预测，为构建语音层面的诈骗早期检测系统提供了数据支撑和基线方法。

items.title: Poisoning Agentic Alpha: Adversarial Vulnerabilities Across Roles and Architectures in Multi-Agent Trading Systems
items.summary: LLM-based multi-agent trading systems, in which specialized agents collaborate through structured communication to produce trading decisions, are moving rapidly from research prototypes to live deployments that control real assets. The same inter-agent communication that makes them effective also exposes them: a corrupted signal can propagate to the final decision and translate into realized financial loss. Unlike prior attacks that presume privileged access to system internals, we restrict the adversary to what is practically reachable---the source data and prompts agents consume---yielding a low-barrier, and thus democratized threat model instantiated as role-specific adversaries. We present the first systematic empirical study in the financial domain to characterize how an adversarial signal enters a multi-agent trading system and how far it survives toward the decision. Along the role axis, we decompose a widely-used trading pipeline into four functional roles---Analyst, Researcher, Trader, and Risk Manager---and pair each with an attack matched to its interface. Along the structural axis, we evaluate four communication topologies under data- and agent-level attacks, using the Adversarial Signal Preservation Score (APS) as a post-hoc lens on why some designs are more robust than others. We conduct experiments across five assets, two backbones, and two target directions. A central finding is that no architecture is inherently robust. These findings provide insights for the future design of safer and more robust agentic trading systems.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 该论文系统研究了基于大语言模型（LLM）的多智能体交易系统中的对抗性漏洞。这类系统由多个专业智能体通过结构化通信协作生成交易决策，正从研究原型快速走向控制真实资产的实时部署。然而，智能体间的通信在提升效率的同时也引入了攻击面：一个被污染的信号可能传播至最终决策，造成实际财务损失。与以往假设攻击者具有系统内部特权访问的攻击不同，本文将攻击者的能力限制在实际可触及的范围——即智能体消费的源数据和提示词——从而构建了一个低门槛、去中心化的威胁模型，具体实例化为不同角色的攻击者。论文首次在金融领域开展了系统性实证研究，刻画对抗性信号如何进入多智能体交易系统以及能在多大程度上影响最终决策。在角色维度上，作者将常用交易流水线分解为四个功能角色：分析师、研究员、交易员和风险经理，并为每个角色匹配合适的攻击方式。在结构维度上，评估了四种通信拓扑在数据级和智能体级攻击下的表现，并提出对抗信号保留分数（Adversarial Signal Preservation Score, APS）作为事后分析工具，用于解释为何某些设计比其他设计更具鲁棒性。实验覆盖五种资产、两个主干模型和两个目标方向。核心发现是：没有任何架构天然免疫。这些结果为设计更安全、更鲁棒的多智能体交易系统提供了洞见。适合人工智能安全、金融科技、多智能体系统等领域的研究人员阅读。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 多智能体交易系统已开始落地，其通信链路可能成为新型攻击面。本文首次系统揭示这类系统的对抗性脆弱性，对蓝队评估AI系统安全、设计鲁棒架构具有直接参考价值。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 影响所有基于LLM的多智能体交易系统及其部署场景，包括涉及真实资金的自动交易平台。研究结论可迁移至其他多智能体协作系统（如智能客服、自动化运维）的安全评估。

items.why_it_matters: 多智能体交易系统已开始落地，其通信链路可能成为新型攻击面。本文首次系统揭示这类系统的对抗性脆弱性，对蓝队评估AI系统安全、设计鲁棒架构具有直接参考价值。

items.title: ToolMinimize: Auditing and Rewriting LLM Agent Tool Calls to Minimize Privacy Exposure
items.summary: LLM agents routinely include privacy-sensitive data (PSD) in tool call arguments beyond what the invoked tools require, crossing trust boundaries to third-party services on every invocation. A controlled measurement on three production LLMs (GPT-4o, Claude 3.5 Sonnet, Llama-3.3-70B) shows that 81--88\% of tool calls include unnecessary PSD under default prompts; explicit privacy instructions still leave 36--76\% over-sharing. Existing defenses gate calls (allow/block) or label flows (information-flow control) but cannot \emph{rewrite} argument values, and PII detection tools miss implicit PSD like ``Memorial Sloan Kettering'' (a hospital name that implies a diagnosis). We present \system{}, a middleware that intercepts tool calls and rewrites their arguments to the minimum data necessary for tool functionality, combining schema-aware necessity analysis with four operations: removal, generalization, substitution, and truncation. Live validation on 307 tool calls across the three LLMs above reduces privacy cost by 81.2--92.0\% at 100\% argument-level task validity (TOST equivalence $p{<}0.001$ at $Δ{=}1.0$); on 25 unannotated Model Context Protocol (MCP) schemas, by 79.0\% with no \texttt{minimum\_necessary} metadata. An optional LLM content-necessity layer strips task-irrelevant PSD from otherwise-necessary free-text fields, raising live-LLM reduction to 85.1--95.6\% and author-schema reduction from 71.1\% to 90.9\%. Median latency is 1.77\,ms.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 本文（ToolMinimize）针对LLM智能体在工具调用中过度暴露隐私敏感数据（PSD）的问题开展研究。作者通过在GPT-4o、Claude 3.5 Sonnet和Llama-3.3-70B三个生产级大语言模型上的受控测量发现，在默认提示词下，81%至88%的工具调用参数包含工具运行所不必要的数据；即便添加显式隐私指令，仍有36%至76%的调用存在过度共享。现有防御手段（如允许/阻断的调用门控、信息流控制标签）无法重写参数值，而传统PII检测工具难以识别隐式PSD（例如“Memorial Sloan Kettering”作为医院名称可隐含疾病诊断）。为此，作者提出ToolMinimize中间件：它拦截工具调用，通过结合模式感知的必要性分析，对参数执行四种操作——删除、泛化、替换和截断——将参数重写为维持工具功能所需的最小数据。在307个实际工具调用上的验证表明，该方法在参数级任务有效性达到100%的前提下（TOST等价检验p<0.001，Delta=1.0），将隐私成本降低81.2%至92.0%。在25个未标注的MCP（Model Context Protocol）模式上，即使没有minimum_necessary元数据，也能降低79.0%。文章还提出可选的内容必要性层，利用LLM从本为必要的自由文本字段中剥离与任务无关的PSD，使实际LLM的降幅提升至85.1%-95.6%，作者自定义模式的降幅从71.1%提升至90.9%。系统中间延迟为1.77毫秒。该研究兼具工程实用性与学术贡献，适合LLM应用开发者、隐私工程师和AI安全研究员阅读。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: LLM智能体普遍向第三方工具发送多余隐私数据，现有防护无法重写参数。ToolMinimize提供实时、低延迟、可验证的中间件方案，能显著降低隐私泄露风险，对构建合规的智能体应用具有直接参考价值。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 适用于所有通过工具调用与外部服务交互的LLM智能体系统，尤其涉及医疗、金融等敏感数据场景；可集成到MCP协议栈或企业API网关中。
detection_signals_zh: 工具调用参数中包含超出模式定义必需字段的敏感数据
自由文本字段中隐含疾病、身份等可推断信息
同一模式下不同调用的参数冗余度异常偏高
defense_advice_zh: 在LLM与工具之间部署参数重写中间件，实施最小必要数据原则
对工具模式进行必要性标注，并定期审核参数冗余度
对隐式PSD（如机构名、日期组合）建立识别规则，避免仅依赖PII扫描

items.title: What Guides the Agent? Adjudicating Unauthorized Behavior via Localizing Behavior-Guiding Instructions
items.summary: LLM agents integrated with external resources gain complex task capabilities, yet the unified natural-language context channel makes them vulnerable to injection attacks: untrusted external data may be dynamically parsed as behavior-guiding instructions during LLM inference, thereby subverting the agent's decision. Existing defenses focus on static detection or isolation of malicious content at the input/output level, remains insufficient for detecting such dynamic inducements that arise during model reasoning. We propose Attnlocate, a runtime framework for fine-grained localization of context spans that genuinely influence tool-calling decisions, i.e., behavior-guiding instructions. Attnlocate casts this localization problem as an object detection task, aiming to detect the distinctive activation traces induced by behavior-guiding instructions within the attention matrix. Specifically, we design a multi-head, multi-layer attention aggregation scheme to construct a token-level feature space tailored for object detection. Then, a 1-D U-Net equipped with an anchor-free detection head is deployed to detect these spans. Finally, based on the authority of the provider from which the detected behavior-guiding spans originate, Attnlocate dynamically adjudicates malicious invocation attempts. We evaluate Attnlocate across ten agent configurations from five LLM families, covering scenarios involving indirect prompt injection and tool poisoning. Attnlocate achieves a mean IoU of 0.743, an average AUROC of 0.956, and a 0.934 true-positive rate at 0.067 false-positive rate. It also transfers effectively across unseen models and supports authority policy adaptation without retraining.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 本文研究了大语言模型（LLM）智能体在集成外部资源后所面临的安全威胁。由于智能体依赖统一的自然语言上下文通道进行推理，不可信的外部数据（如网页内容、工具返回结果）可能被动态解析为行为引导指令，从而劫持智能体的决策过程，实现间接提示注入或工具投毒攻击。现有防御手段主要停留在输入/输出层面的静态检测或恶意内容隔离，难以应对模型推理过程中动态产生的诱导行为。针对这一问题，作者提出了一种名为 Attnlocate 的运行时框架，能够对真正影响工具调用决策的上下文片段（即行为引导指令）进行细粒度定位。该框架将定位问题建模为目标检测任务，通过设计多头、多层的注意力聚合方案，构建面向目标检测的 token 级特征空间，并采用带无锚框检测头的一维 U-Net 网络来识别这些片段。最后，根据检测到的行为引导片段来源方的权限级别，Attnlocate 动态裁决恶意调用尝试。作者在来自五个 LLM 家族的十种智能体配置上进行了评估，覆盖间接提示注入和工具投毒场景，取得了 0.743 的平均 IoU、0.956 的平均 AUROC，以及在 0.067 假阳性率下 0.934 的真阳性率。该方法还能有效迁移到未见过的模型，并支持无需重新训练的权限策略自适应。本文的核心贡献在于首次将注意力矩阵中的激活痕迹用于行为引导指令的定位，为智能体运行时防御提供了新思路。适合 LLM 安全研究者、智能体框架开发者及蓝队安全工程师阅读。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: LLM 智能体正被广泛集成到业务中，但其统一上下文通道可被注入攻击利用。Attnlocate 提供了一种运行时细粒度定位行为引导指令的新方法，有助于检测动态诱导攻击，为智能体安全防御提供了可落地的技术路径。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 影响使用 LLM 智能体并接入不可信外部数据源的系统，如网页浏览代理、工具调用代理、RAG 应用等。其方法可迁移至其他基于注意力机制的模型，用于检测恶意指令注入场景。
detection_signals_zh: 注意力矩阵中出现异常的跨头、跨层激活模式
工具调用决策前存在上下文片段被高注意力权重聚焦
行为引导指令来源不可信且其权限等级与调用行为不匹配
defense_advice_zh: 在运行时监控注意力矩阵，识别可能的行为引导指令片段
结合来源权限动态裁决工具调用，避免低权限来源触发高权限操作
对检测到的可疑片段进行隔离或重新生成上下文，阻断注入链路
